questions.questionEn: A 24-year-old male cut his forearm with a circular saw. Bright red blood is spurting from a 6 cm laceration. He is alert, HR 102, BP 128/84. What is your first action to control the hemorrhage?
questions.questionZh: 一名24岁男性用圆锯割伤前臂，6厘米的伤口喷出鲜红色血液。患者清醒，心率102，血压128/84。控制出血的首要措施是什么？

options.en: Apply a tourniquet proximal to the wound
options.zh: 在伤口近端使用止血带

options.en: Elevate the arm above the level of the heart
options.zh: 将手臂抬高至心脏水平以上

options.en: Apply direct pressure to the wound
options.zh: 对伤口直接加压

options.en: Pack the wound with hemostatic gauze
options.zh: 用止血纱布填塞伤口

questions.explanationEn: BC guidelines list hemorrhage control methods in order of preference: direct pressure first, then pressure dressing, positioning the part, positioning the patient, tourniquet, and finally wound packing. A tourniquet is only applied if direct pressure fails to control the bleeding.
questions.explanationZh: BC指南按优先顺序列出止血方法：先直接加压，再加压敷料、抬高患肢、调整患者体位、止血带，最后是伤口填塞。只有直接加压无法控制出血时才使用止血带。

questions.questionEn: A 35-year-old male has a deep mid-thigh laceration from a chainsaw. Direct pressure and a pressure dressing have failed to control the arterial bleeding. He is pale, HR 124, BP 96/60. What is the next appropriate intervention?
questions.questionZh: 一名35岁男性大腿中段被链锯深度割伤。直接加压和加压敷料均未能控制动脉出血。患者面色苍白，心率124，血压96/60。下一步适当的处置是什么？

options.en: Apply a tourniquet proximal to the wound and note the time
options.zh: 在伤口近端使用止血带并记录时间

options.en: Add more gauze on top of the soaked dressing and continue pressure
options.zh: 在浸透的敷料上再叠加纱布并继续加压

options.en: Pack the wound and apply a fresh pressure dressing
options.zh: 填塞伤口并重新使用加压敷料

options.en: Elevate the leg and apply cold to slow the bleeding
options.zh: 抬高下肢并冷敷以减缓出血

questions.explanationEn: The thigh is an area amenable to tourniquet application. When direct pressure fails, the guideline directs applying a tourniquet proximal to the wound; note the time and never release it once applied. Wound packing is reserved for junctional areas not amenable to a tourniquet.
questions.explanationZh: 大腿属于可使用止血带的部位。当直接加压失败时，指南要求在伤口近端使用止血带，记录时间且一旦使用绝不松开。伤口填塞仅用于无法使用止血带的交界部位。

questions.questionEn: A 31-year-old male has been stabbed in the left groin. Blood is pooling rapidly despite firm direct pressure. He is diaphoretic, HR 132, BP 88/54. A tourniquet cannot be effectively applied to this location. What should you do?
questions.questionZh: 一名31岁男性左腹股沟被刺伤。尽管持续用力直接加压，血液仍迅速积聚。患者大汗，心率132，血压88/54。该部位无法有效使用止血带。你应该怎么做？

options.en: Apply a pelvic binder to tamponade the bleeding vessel
options.zh: 使用骨盆固定带压迫止血

options.en: Apply a tourniquet as high on the thigh as possible
options.zh: 尽可能在大腿高位使用止血带

options.en: Maintain direct pressure only and initiate rapid transport
options.zh: 仅维持直接加压并立即快速转运

options.en: Pack the wound to control the junctional hemorrhage
options.zh: 填塞伤口以控制交界部位出血

questions.explanationEn: For junctional hemorrhage in areas not amenable to tourniquet application, such as the groin, BC guidelines direct wound packing when direct pressure fails. Packing is prohibited only for wounds of the neck, chest, or abdomen. A thigh tourniquet would sit distal to or over the wound and cannot control groin bleeding.
questions.explanationZh: 对于腹股沟等无法使用止血带部位的交界性出血，当直接加压失败时，BC指南要求进行伤口填塞。只有颈部、胸部和腹部的伤口禁止填塞。大腿止血带位置在伤口远端或伤口上，无法控制腹股沟出血。

questions.questionEn: A 78-year-old female on warfarin has a deep lower-leg laceration that did not stop bleeding with direct pressure. You applied a tourniquet at 14:32 and the bleeding stopped. Transport time is 40 minutes. How should the tourniquet be managed?
questions.questionZh: 一名78岁女性服用华法林，小腿深部裂伤直接加压无法止血。你于14:32使用止血带后出血停止。转运需40分钟。应如何管理止血带？

options.en: Loosen it every 15 minutes to allow distal perfusion
options.zh: 每15分钟松开一次以恢复远端灌注

options.en: Document the application time and do not release it
options.zh: 记录使用时间且不再松开

options.en: Convert it to a pressure dressing once clotting begins
options.zh: 一旦开始凝血就改用加压敷料

options.en: Release it when transport time exceeds 30 minutes
options.zh: 转运时间超过30分钟时松开

questions.explanationEn: BC guidelines are explicit: when a tourniquet is applied, note the time and do not release it once applied. Intermittent loosening allows repeated hemorrhage and worsens outcomes, particularly in an anticoagulated elderly patient.
questions.explanationZh: BC指南明确规定：使用止血带时应记录时间，一旦使用绝不松开。间断松开会导致反复出血并恶化预后，尤其是服用抗凝药的老年患者。

questions.questionEn: Direct pressure has failed to control severe bleeding in each of the following wounds. According to BC guidelines, which wound location is appropriate for wound packing?
questions.questionZh: 以下伤口经直接加压均无法控制严重出血。根据BC指南，哪个部位的伤口适合进行伤口填塞？

options.en: A stab wound to the lateral neck
options.zh: 颈部外侧刺伤

options.en: A deep wound in the axilla
options.zh: 腋窝深部伤口

options.en: A penetrating wound to the chest wall
options.zh: 胸壁穿透伤

options.en: A stab wound to the abdomen
options.zh: 腹部刺伤

questions.explanationEn: Wound packing is indicated for junctional hemorrhage in areas not amenable to a tourniquet, such as the axilla or groin. The guideline explicitly prohibits packing wounds of the neck, chest, or abdomen.
questions.explanationZh: 伤口填塞适用于无法使用止血带的交界部位出血，如腋窝或腹股沟。指南明确禁止填塞颈部、胸部或腹部的伤口。

questions.questionEn: A 9-year-old boy fell while running with a wooden stick, which is now embedded through his cheek into the oral cavity. Blood is running into his mouth, he is gurgling and unable to clear it despite suction. What is the appropriate management of the embedded object?
questions.questionZh: 一名9岁男孩奔跑时摔倒，木棍穿透面颊进入口腔。血液流入口中，患儿发出咕噜声，抽吸后仍无法清理气道。对该嵌入物的正确处理是什么？

options.en: Stabilize the stick in place with bulky dressings and transport
options.zh: 用厚敷料原位固定木棍后转运

options.en: Shorten the stick with cutters and secure the remainder
options.zh: 剪短木棍并固定其余部分

options.en: Leave the stick untouched and place him supine for transport
options.zh: 不触碰木棍，让其仰卧位转运

options.en: Remove the object because it is compromising the airway
options.zh: 因其危及气道而移除嵌入物

questions.explanationEn: Embedded objects should be stabilized in place, unless the object is impairing the airway. Here the object is causing airway compromise that suctioning and positioning cannot resolve, so removal is warranted, followed by bleeding control and airway management.
questions.explanationZh: 嵌入物原则上应原位固定，除非其危及气道。本例嵌入物导致气道受累，抽吸和体位无法解决，因此应移除，随后控制出血并管理气道。

questions.questionEn: An 81-year-old male fell down three stairs. His right wrist is grossly deformed and the radial pulse distal to the injury is absent. You realign the limb to anatomical position and the pulse returns. How should this patient now be categorized?
questions.questionZh: 一名81岁男性从三级台阶跌落。右腕明显畸形，损伤远端桡动脉搏动消失。你将肢体复位至解剖位后脉搏恢复。该患者现在应如何归类？

options.en: Treated as stable, with ongoing reassessment of distal circulation
options.zh: 按稳定患者处理，持续复评远端循环

options.en: Managed as unstable because the limb was initially pulseless
options.zh: 因肢体最初无脉而按不稳定处理

options.en: Rapid transport regardless because of his age
options.zh: 因其年龄一律快速转运

options.en: A second realignment attempt to confirm circulation
options.zh: 再次复位以确认循环

questions.explanationEn: If a limb is pulseless distal to an injury, one attempt can be made to realign it to the anatomical position. If circulation returns, the patient can be treated as stable; if the limb remains pulseless, the patient is managed as unstable.
questions.explanationZh: 若损伤远端肢体无脉，可尝试一次复位至解剖位。若循环恢复，患者可按稳定处理；若仍无脉，则按不稳定患者管理。

questions.questionEn: A 6-year-old girl's index finger was completely amputated in a slammed car door. Bleeding from the stump is controlled and she is stable. How should the amputated finger be preserved for transport?
questions.questionZh: 一名6岁女孩的食指被车门完全夹断。断端出血已控制，患儿情况稳定。断指应如何保存转运？

options.en: Submerge it in a container of cool sterile water
options.zh: 浸泡在装有凉无菌水的容器中

options.en: Place it directly on ice inside a sealed bag
options.zh: 直接放在密封袋内的冰块上

options.en: Wrap it loosely in saline-moistened sterile gauze, place it in a plastic bag, and keep it cool
options.zh: 用生理盐水浸湿的无菌纱布松松包裹，放入塑料袋中保持低温

options.en: Wrap it in dry gauze and keep it warm against the caregiver's body
options.zh: 用干纱布包裹并贴近照护者身体保温

questions.explanationEn: After rinsing gross contamination with cool sterile water, the part is wrapped loosely in saline-moistened sterile gauze, placed in a plastic bag, and kept cool in a protective container, transported with the patient. Never warm the part, submerge it in water, place it directly on ice, or use dry ice.
questions.explanationZh: 用凉无菌水冲洗明显污染后，断指应用生理盐水浸湿的无菌纱布松松包裹，放入塑料袋，置于保护容器中保持低温，并与患者一同转运。切勿加温、泡水、直接放冰上或使用干冰。

questions.questionEn: According to BC guidelines on preservation of amputated parts, which of the following statements is correct?
questions.questionZh: 根据BC指南关于断离部位保存的规定，下列哪项说法正确？

options.en: The part should be kept cool in a plastic bag inside a protective container
options.zh: 断离部位应装入塑料袋置于保护容器中保持低温

options.en: Dry ice may be used when regular ice is unavailable
options.zh: 无普通冰块时可使用干冰

options.en: The part should be transported in a container of iced water
options.zh: 断离部位应放在冰水容器中转运

options.en: The part should remain at body temperature until reattachment
options.zh: 断离部位应保持体温直至再植

questions.explanationEn: The amputated part is placed inside a plastic bag and kept cool in a protective container. The key points prohibit warming the part, placing it in water, placing it directly on ice, and using dry ice.
questions.explanationZh: 断离部位应放入塑料袋并置于保护容器中保持低温。要点明确禁止加温、泡水、直接接触冰块及使用干冰。

questions.questionEn: A 3-week-old infant rolled off a change table and has a 2 cm scalp laceration bleeding steadily. The infant is alert and crying with good tone. What is the first step to control the bleeding?
questions.questionZh: 一名3周大的婴儿从尿布台滚落，头皮有一处2厘米裂伤，持续出血。婴儿清醒、哭声响亮、肌张力好。控制出血的第一步是什么？

options.en: Apply a cold pack directly onto the open wound
options.zh: 将冰袋直接敷在开放伤口上

options.en: Bandage the wound immediately without applying pressure
options.zh: 不加压立即包扎伤口

options.en: Apply gentle direct pressure to the wound with sterile gauze
options.zh: 用无菌纱布对伤口轻柔直接加压

options.en: Apply a circumferential head tourniquet above the ears
options.zh: 在耳上方环绕头部加压止血带

questions.explanationEn: Direct pressure is the first-line method of hemorrhage control at every age. The wound is bandaged after hemorrhage has been controlled. Cold is not applied directly to an open bleeding wound as a first step, and tourniquets are for limbs, not the head.
questions.explanationZh: 任何年龄段，直接加压都是控制出血的首选方法。出血控制后再进行包扎。冷敷不能作为第一步直接用于开放性出血伤口，止血带只用于四肢而非头部。

questions.questionEn: A 70-year-old male was gored by cattle and has loops of bowel protruding from a lower abdominal wound. He is alert, HR 110, BP 104/70. How should the eviscerated bowel be managed?
questions.questionZh: 一名70岁男性被牛角顶伤，下腹部伤口有肠管脱出。患者清醒，心率110，血压104/70。脱出的肠管应如何处理？

options.en: Gently replace the bowel into the abdominal cavity and cover with dry gauze
options.zh: 轻轻将肠管还纳入腹腔并覆盖干纱布

options.en: Cover it with moist sterile dressings followed by an occlusive layer
options.zh: 用湿润无菌敷料覆盖，外加封闭层

options.en: Pack the wound edges firmly to prevent further evisceration
options.zh: 紧密填塞伤口边缘防止进一步脱出

options.en: Apply a dry pressure dressing directly over the bowel
options.zh: 直接在肠管上使用干燥加压敷料

questions.explanationEn: Eviscerated abdominal contents are covered with moist, sterile dressings followed by an occlusive layer, and must never be replaced into the abdominal cavity. Abdominal wounds must not be packed, and heat loss should be prevented.
questions.explanationZh: 脱出的腹腔内容物应先用湿润无菌敷料覆盖，再加封闭层，绝不可还纳入腹腔。腹部伤口不可填塞，同时要防止热量丢失。

questions.questionEn: A 68-year-old female was in a high-speed MVC 3.5 hours ago in a remote area. She has abdominal bruising, HR 122, BP 86/58, and cool clammy skin. Vascular access is established en route. Regarding TXA, what is the correct decision?
questions.questionZh: 一名68岁女性3.5小时前在偏远地区发生高速车祸。腹部瘀伤，心率122，血压86/58，皮肤湿冷。转运途中已建立静脉通路。关于TXA，正确的决定是什么？

options.en: Administer TXA 2 g IV push over 1 minute
options.zh: TXA 2克静脉推注，1分钟内推完

options.en: Administer half the usual TXA dose due to her age
options.zh: 因其年龄给予常规TXA剂量的一半

options.en: Administer TXA only after a 2-litre fluid bolus
options.zh: 先输注2升液体后再给TXA

options.en: Withhold TXA because more than 3 hours have elapsed since injury
options.zh: 因受伤已超过3小时而不给TXA

questions.explanationEn: TXA is contraindicated if more than 3 hours have elapsed since the injury, along with hypersensitivity, age under 12, and isolated TBI. Although she shows signs of shock with a mechanism suggesting occult bleeding, the 3.5-hour interval rules TXA out.
questions.explanationZh: 受伤超过3小时是TXA的禁忌证，其他禁忌还包括过敏、12岁以下和单纯颅脑损伤。虽然她有休克表现且机制提示隐匿性出血，但已过3.5小时，禁用TXA。

questions.questionEn: A 25-year-old male fell snowboarding and has a deformed, painful mid-forearm with intact distal pulses. He is stable. When splinting this injury in the treatment component, what must be included?
questions.questionZh: 一名25岁男性滑雪板摔伤，前臂中段畸形疼痛，远端脉搏存在，情况稳定。在治疗环节夹板固定该损伤时，必须包括什么？

options.en: Traction applied through the wrist before splinting
options.zh: 固定前经腕部施加牵引

options.en: A circumferential elastic bandage over the fracture site
options.zh: 在骨折处环形加压弹性绷带

options.en: Cold applied directly against the skin under the splint
options.zh: 夹板下直接贴皮肤冷敷

options.en: Immobilization of the joints above and below the injury site
options.zh: 固定损伤部位上下两个关节

questions.explanationEn: For musculoskeletal injuries, the treatment component requires immobilizing the joints above and below the injury site — here the elbow and wrist. Traction splinting is only for suspected mid-shaft femur fractures, and cold must not impair circulation or be applied directly to skin.
questions.explanationZh: 对肌肉骨骼损伤，治疗环节要求固定损伤部位上下两个关节——本例为肘关节和腕关节。牵引夹板仅用于疑似股骨干中段骨折，冷敷不能影响循环也不应直接贴皮肤。

questions.questionEn: Which of the following patients is an appropriate candidate for a traction splint?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪位患者适合使用牵引夹板？

options.en: An 82-year-old with a suspected hip fracture after a fall
options.zh: 82岁跌倒后疑似髋部骨折的患者

options.en: A stable 68-year-old with an isolated closed mid-shaft femur deformity
options.zh: 病情稳定的68岁患者，单纯闭合性股骨干中段畸形

options.en: An unstable 70-year-old with a femur fracture and chest trauma
options.zh: 病情不稳定的70岁患者，股骨骨折合并胸部创伤

options.en: A 75-year-old with an isolated ankle fracture-dislocation
options.zh: 75岁单纯踝关节骨折脱位的患者

questions.explanationEn: Traction splints are indicated for suspected mid-shaft femur fractures in stable patients only. Hip fractures and other fracture locations are not indications, and unstable patients require rapid transport rather than time-consuming traction splinting.
questions.explanationZh: 牵引夹板仅适用于病情稳定患者的疑似股骨干中段骨折。髋部骨折及其他部位骨折均非适应证，不稳定患者需要快速转运而不是耗时的牵引固定。

questions.questionEn: You are applying a Sager splint to a stable 80 kg (176 lb) male with a closed mid-shaft femur fracture. How much traction should be applied?
questions.questionZh: 你正在为一名体重80公斤（176磅）、病情稳定的男性闭合性股骨干中段骨折患者使用Sager牵引夹板。应施加多少牵引力？

options.en: 18 lbs, exactly 10% of his body weight
options.zh: 18磅，即体重的10%

options.en: 5 lbs, the standard for all femur fractures
options.zh: 5磅，所有股骨骨折的标准值

options.en: 15 lbs, because 10% of body weight exceeds the maximum
options.zh: 15磅，因为体重的10%超过了最大限值

options.en: 22 lbs, to ensure adequate bony alignment
options.zh: 22磅，以确保骨折对线充分

questions.explanationEn: For closed mid-shaft femur fractures, traction is 10% of body weight to a maximum of 15 lbs (7 kg). Ten percent of 176 lbs is 17.6 lbs, which exceeds the cap, so 15 lbs is applied. Once applied, traction is never released.
questions.explanationZh: 闭合性股骨干中段骨折的牵引力为体重的10%，最大不超过15磅（7公斤）。176磅的10%为17.6磅，超过上限，因此施加15磅。牵引一旦施加绝不松开。

questions.questionEn: A stable 30-year-old male has an open mid-shaft femur fracture with bone ends visible. A Sager splint is indicated. What is the maximum traction for this injury?
questions.questionZh: 一名30岁病情稳定的男性开放性股骨干中段骨折，可见骨折端外露。需要使用Sager牵引夹板。该损伤的最大牵引力是多少？

options.en: 5 lbs maximum
options.zh: 最大5磅

options.en: 10% of body weight to a maximum of 15 lbs
options.zh: 体重的10%，最大15磅

options.en: 7 kg regardless of fracture type
options.zh: 无论骨折类型均为7公斤

options.en: No traction; open fractures contraindicate the Sager splint
options.zh: 不牵引；开放性骨折禁用Sager夹板

questions.explanationEn: Open mid-shaft femur fractures receive a maximum of 5 lbs of traction, compared with 10% of body weight to a maximum of 15 lbs (7 kg) for closed fractures. Limiting traction in open fractures avoids drawing contaminated bone ends back into the wound with excessive force.
questions.explanationZh: 开放性股骨干中段骨折的牵引力最大为5磅，而闭合性骨折为体重的10%、最大15磅（7公斤）。限制开放性骨折的牵引力可避免过大力量将污染的骨折端拉回伤口深处。

questions.questionEn: A 45-year-old logger has a grossly deformed mid-thigh, decreased breath sounds on the left, HR 124, BP 88/56. Your partner begins preparing the Sager splint. What is the correct course of action?
questions.questionZh: 一名45岁伐木工人大腿中段明显畸形，左侧呼吸音减弱，心率124，血压88/56。你的搭档开始准备Sager牵引夹板。正确的做法是什么？

options.en: Apply the traction splint before moving him to prevent fat embolism
options.zh: 移动前先上牵引夹板以防脂肪栓塞

options.en: Apply traction en route once the primary survey is complete
options.zh: 完成初步评估后在转运途中施加牵引

options.en: Withhold the traction splint, manually stabilize the limb, and initiate rapid transport
options.zh: 不使用牵引夹板，手法固定患肢并立即快速转运

options.en: Apply 5 lbs of traction only, given his hypotension
options.zh: 鉴于低血压仅施加5磅牵引

questions.explanationEn: Traction splints are indicated only for suspected mid-shaft femur fractures in stable patients. This patient is unstable with signs of chest injury and shock; scene time must not be extended for traction splinting. Stabilize the limb and transport rapidly.
questions.explanationZh: 牵引夹板仅适用于病情稳定患者的疑似股骨干中段骨折。该患者不稳定，伴胸部损伤和休克表现，不应为上牵引夹板延长现场时间。应手法固定患肢并快速转运。

questions.questionEn: An 82-year-old female tripped on a rug at home. Her left leg is shortened and externally rotated with pain in the hip region. HR 92, BP 138/84. How should this injury be stabilized for transport?
questions.questionZh: 一名82岁女性在家被地毯绊倒。左下肢短缩外旋，髋部疼痛。心率92，血压138/84。该损伤应如何固定转运？

options.en: Support the limb with rolled blankets and ties on a firm stretcher; do not apply a pelvic binder
options.zh: 在硬质担架上用卷毯和绑带支撑患肢；不使用骨盆固定带

options.en: Apply a pelvic binder centered over the greater trochanters
options.zh: 使用骨盆固定带，中心对准股骨大转子

options.en: Apply a traction splint to restore limb length
options.zh: 使用牵引夹板恢复肢体长度

options.en: Walk her to the stretcher to assess weight-bearing first
options.zh: 先扶她走到担架评估负重能力

questions.explanationEn: This presentation suggests a neck-of-femur (hip) fracture from a simple fall — both explicit contraindications to pelvic binding. Traction splints are only for mid-shaft femur fractures. The limb is supported with rolled blankets and ties, and the patient secured to a firm stretcher.
questions.explanationZh: 该表现提示单纯跌倒导致的股骨颈（髋部）骨折——两者均为骨盆固定带的明确禁忌证。牵引夹板仅用于股骨干中段骨折。应用卷毯和绑带支撑患肢，并将患者固定在硬质担架上。

questions.questionEn: A 75-year-old male has a suspected hip dislocation after a frontal MVC. Distal pulses and sensation in the limb are intact. What transport category applies?
questions.questionZh: 一名75岁男性正面车祸后疑似髋关节脱位。患肢远端脉搏和感觉正常。适用什么转运级别？

options.en: Routine transport because distal circulation is intact
options.zh: 因远端循环正常而常规转运

options.en: Rapid transport only if pain is uncontrolled
options.zh: 仅在疼痛无法控制时快速转运

options.en: Transport category is decided by the receiving hospital
options.zh: 转运级别由接收医院决定

options.en: Rapid Transport Category, as for all hip dislocations
options.zh: 快速转运级别，所有髋关节脱位均如此

questions.explanationEn: All hip dislocations are in the Rapid Transport Category regardless of distal findings, because early medical reduction is essential to avoid serious long-term complications. A dislocation with neurovascular impairment is additionally considered limb-threatening.
questions.explanationZh: 所有髋关节脱位无论远端检查结果如何均属快速转运级别，因为早期医疗复位对避免严重远期并发症至关重要。若合并神经血管损害则进一步视为肢体威胁性损伤。

questions.questionEn: During transport of a 79-year-old with a suspected hip dislocation, the patient reports sudden relief of pain and the limb appears to have returned to normal position. What must you do?
questions.questionZh: 转运一名79岁疑似髋关节脱位患者途中，患者诉疼痛突然缓解，患肢外观恢复正常位置。你必须做什么？

options.en: Downgrade to routine transport since the injury has resolved
options.zh: 因损伤已解决而降为常规转运

options.en: Update the receiving hospital that the hip has spontaneously reduced
options.zh: 通知接收医院髋关节已自行复位

options.en: Re-dislocate is impossible, so no further monitoring is needed
options.zh: 不会再脱位，无需进一步监测

options.en: Stop the ambulance and splint the hip in the new position
options.zh: 停车并按新位置固定髋部

questions.explanationEn: If a suspected dislocation spontaneously reduces during treatment or transport, the guideline requires updating the receiving hospital. Regular checks of vitals, distal pulses, and neurological function in the limb continue throughout.
questions.explanationZh: 若疑似脱位在治疗或转运过程中自行复位，指南要求通知接收医院。同时继续定期检查生命体征、远端脉搏和患肢神经功能。

questions.questionEn: A 73-year-old with a hip dislocation after an MVC has absent pedal pulses and numbness in the affected foot. How is this injury classified?
questions.questionZh: 一名73岁患者车祸后髋关节脱位，患侧足背动脉搏动消失并伴足部麻木。该损伤如何归类？

options.en: A stable injury requiring routine transport
options.zh: 稳定损伤，常规转运即可

options.en: A limb-threatening injury
options.zh: 肢体威胁性损伤

options.en: A minor injury once the limb is supported
options.zh: 肢体支撑后即为轻伤

options.en: A life-threatening injury requiring a pelvic binder
options.zh: 危及生命的损伤，需要骨盆固定带

questions.explanationEn: A hip dislocation with neurological or vascular impairment is considered a limb-threatening injury. All hip dislocations are in the Rapid Transport Category; the neurovascular deficit adds urgency but a pelvic binder is not the treatment for dislocation.
questions.explanationZh: 合并神经或血管损害的髋关节脱位属于肢体威胁性损伤。所有髋关节脱位均为快速转运级别；神经血管障碍增加了紧迫性，但骨盆固定带并非脱位的治疗方法。

questions.questionEn: A 40-year-old motorcyclist struck a barrier at highway speed. He complains of pelvic pain, HR 118, BP 84/50. Palpation reveals pelvic instability. What is the correct intervention before transport?
questions.questionZh: 一名40岁摩托车手以高速公路车速撞上护栏。主诉骨盆疼痛，心率118，血压84/50，触诊发现骨盆不稳定。转运前的正确处置是什么？

options.en: Secure the pelvis with zap straps at the iliac crests
options.zh: 用束线带在髂嵴水平固定骨盆

options.en: Log roll him onto a spine board and bind the pelvis at the iliac crests
options.zh: 轴线翻身至脊柱板后在髂嵴水平捆绑骨盆

options.en: Defer binding until arrival at hospital to allow imaging
options.zh: 暂不捆绑，到院后再做影像检查

options.en: Apply a commercial pelvic binder centered over the greater trochanters
options.zh: 使用商用骨盆固定带，中心对准股骨大转子

questions.explanationEn: Major mechanism plus hemodynamic instability (HR > 100 or SBP < 90), pelvic pain, or pelvic instability indicates pelvic binding, which should occur before transport. The binder is centered over the greater trochanters. Zap straps are explicitly unacceptable, and the patient should not be rolled to apply the binder.
questions.explanationZh: 高能量机制加血流动力学不稳定（心率>100或收缩压<90）、骨盆疼痛或骨盆不稳定即为骨盆捆绑适应证，且应在转运前完成。固定带中心应对准股骨大转子。指南明确束线带不可接受，捆绑时不应翻动患者。

questions.questionEn: You suspect an unstable pelvic fracture in a 33-year-old after a fall from scaffolding, but no commercial binder is available. What is the acceptable alternative?
questions.questionZh: 一名33岁患者从脚手架坠落，你怀疑不稳定性骨盆骨折，但没有商用骨盆固定带。可接受的替代方法是什么？

options.en: Three overlapping broad triangular bandages tied to support the pelvis
options.zh: 三条重叠的宽三角巾捆扎以支撑骨盆

options.en: Heavy-duty zap straps tightened across the trochanters
options.zh: 在大转子处收紧重型束线带

options.en: A blanket rolled under the lumbar spine
options.zh: 腰椎下垫一条卷起的毛毯

options.en: Firm circumferential taping of the hips to the spine board
options.zh: 用胶带将髋部环形固定于脊柱板

questions.explanationEn: The pelvis is bound with a commercial binder or three overlapping broad triangular bandages, tied tightly enough to support the pelvis without causing pain, centered on the greater trochanter. Zap straps are explicitly not acceptable.
questions.explanationZh: 骨盆应使用商用固定带或三条重叠的宽三角巾捆绑，松紧以支撑骨盆但不引起疼痛为度，中心对准股骨大转子。指南明确规定束线带不可接受。

questions.questionEn: An 11-year-old girl has an isolated, closed deformity of the lower leg after a soccer tackle. She is stable with intact distal pulses but cries with any movement. When should analgesia be provided?
questions.questionZh: 一名11岁女孩足球铲球后单纯闭合性小腿畸形。病情稳定，远端脉搏正常，但任何移动都会使她哭喊。应何时给予镇痛？

options.en: Only after splinting is complete
options.zh: 仅在夹板固定完成后

options.en: Only if transport exceeds 30 minutes
options.zh: 仅当转运超过30分钟时

options.en: Prior to moving the patient, as she is stable and appropriate
options.zh: 在移动患者之前，因其病情稳定且适合

options.en: Analgesia is not given to pediatric fracture patients
options.zh: 儿童骨折患者不给予镇痛

questions.explanationEn: The MSK protocol component directs providing analgesia prior to movement in stable, appropriate patients. Splinting and movement are painful; appropriate analgesia beforehand is expected rather than withheld until afterward.
questions.explanationZh: 肌肉骨骼损伤的处置流程要求：对稳定且适合的患者，在移动之前给予镇痛。夹板固定和搬动都会引起疼痛，应提前镇痛而非事后补救。

questions.questionEn: After splinting a 10-year-old's deformed forearm, what assessment must be repeated throughout the call?
questions.questionZh: 为一名10岁儿童畸形前臂上好夹板后，整个出勤过程中必须反复进行哪项评估？

options.en: Distal pulses and circulation in the injured limb
options.zh: 患肢远端脉搏和循环

options.en: Passive range of motion of the fracture site
options.zh: 骨折部位的被动活动度

options.en: Blood glucose levels
options.zh: 血糖水平

options.en: Pupillary response
options.zh: 瞳孔反应

questions.explanationEn: The MSK guideline directs checking distal pulses and reassessing throughout the call. Splints can shift and swelling can progress, so distal circulation must be reassessed after every intervention and movement.
questions.explanationZh: 肌肉骨骼损伤指南要求检查远端脉搏并在整个出勤过程中反复评估。夹板可能移位、肿胀可能加重，每次处置和搬动后都必须复评远端循环。

questions.questionEn: A Sager splint with 12 lbs of traction was applied to a stable 14-year-old with a closed mid-shaft femur fracture. After moving him onto the stretcher, the ankle harness looks shifted and the traction reads 8 lbs. What should you do?
questions.questionZh: 一名病情稳定的14岁闭合性股骨干中段骨折患者已用Sager夹板施加12磅牵引。将其移上担架后，踝部固定带似有移位，牵引读数降至8磅。你应该怎么做？

options.en: Release the traction fully and reapply the splint from the beginning
options.zh: 完全松开牵引，从头重新安装夹板

options.en: Leave it as is; reduced traction is acceptable once splinted
options.zh: 保持原样；固定后牵引减少可以接受

options.en: Reassess and correct the traction back to the required amount without releasing it
options.zh: 在不松开牵引的前提下复评并将牵引校正回所需数值

options.en: Remove the splint and secure the legs together with a blanket only
options.zh: 拆除夹板，仅用毛毯将双腿绑在一起

questions.explanationEn: With each movement or reassessment of ABCs or vitals, traction should be reassessed and corrected if necessary. Once traction is applied it must NOT be released, so the correction is made without letting the traction off.
questions.explanationZh: 每次搬动或复评ABC及生命体征时，都应重新评估牵引并在必要时校正。牵引一旦施加绝不可松开，因此校正必须在不释放牵引的情况下进行。

questions.questionEn: A 79-year-old female slipped from standing on her kitchen floor. She has left hip pain, a shortened left leg, HR 105, BP 118/76. Your partner suggests a pelvic binder because her heart rate exceeds 100. What is the correct decision?
questions.questionZh: 一名79岁女性在厨房站立时滑倒。左髋疼痛，左腿短缩，心率105，血压118/76。搭档因其心率超过100建议使用骨盆固定带。正确的决定是什么？

options.en: Apply the binder; tachycardia alone mandates binding
options.zh: 使用固定带；单凭心动过速就必须捆绑

options.en: Do not bind; a simple fall with a suspected hip fracture contraindicates the binder
options.zh: 不捆绑；单纯跌倒伴疑似髋部骨折是固定带的禁忌证

options.en: Apply the binder loosely as a compromise
options.zh: 折中处理，松松地捆绑固定带

options.en: Bind only if transport exceeds 20 minutes
options.zh: 仅当转运超过20分钟时捆绑

questions.explanationEn: Pelvic binding requires a major mechanism suggestive of pelvic fracture plus clinical criteria. Falls from standing height and neck-of-femur (hip) fractures are both explicit contraindications. Her presentation suggests a hip fracture from a simple fall, so the binder is withheld and the limb supported instead.
questions.explanationZh: 骨盆捆绑需要提示骨盆骨折的高能量机制加临床指标。站立高度跌倒和股骨颈（髋部）骨折都是明确禁忌证。她的表现提示单纯跌倒所致髋部骨折，因此不用固定带，改为支撑患肢。

questions.questionEn: A 29-year-old driver in a T-bone collision complains of midline neck pain. He is alert and still seated in the vehicle. What is the first spinal intervention?
questions.questionZh: 一名29岁司机侧面碰撞后主诉颈部正中疼痛。患者清醒，仍坐在车内。脊柱处置的第一步是什么？

options.en: Apply a hard collar before touching the head
options.zh: 触碰头部前先上硬质颈托

options.en: Have him self-extricate and lie on the stretcher
options.zh: 让其自行脱困并躺上担架

options.en: Secure him to a spinal device while still seated
options.zh: 在座位上直接固定于脊柱装置

options.en: Manually stabilize the head and neck
options.zh: 手法固定头颈部

questions.explanationEn: When spinal motion restriction is clinically indicated, the sequence begins with manual stabilization of the head and neck, followed by a hard collar, placement on a spinal immobilization device, foam blocks, and securing the body.
questions.explanationZh: 当临床需要脊柱活动限制时，处置顺序首先是手法固定头颈部，然后是硬质颈托、放置于脊柱固定装置、泡沫固定块并固定躯体。

questions.questionEn: When securing a patient to a spinal immobilization device, which of the following is correct according to BC guidelines?
questions.questionZh: 根据BC指南，将患者固定于脊柱固定装置时，下列哪项是正确的？

options.en: Tape the forehead firmly to the device before securing the body
options.zh: 先用胶带将前额牢牢固定于装置再固定躯体

options.en: Leave the hard collar off once the patient is on the device
options.zh: 患者上装置后即可不用硬质颈托

options.en: Foam blocks are only used for unconscious patients
options.zh: 泡沫固定块仅用于昏迷患者

options.en: Secure the patient's body to the device but do not tape the head
options.zh: 将患者躯体固定于装置，但不可用胶带固定头部

questions.explanationEn: The guideline directs placing foam rollers/blocks and securing the patient's body to the spinal device if appropriate, with the explicit instruction not to tape the head.
questions.explanationZh: 指南要求放置泡沫固定块并酌情将患者躯体固定于脊柱装置，同时明确指示不可用胶带固定头部。

questions.questionEn: A 38-year-old male is found unconscious at the bottom of a staircase, breathing adequately, with a scalp hematoma. GCS is 8. Your partner suggests the recovery position for airway protection. What is the appropriate management?
questions.questionZh: 一名38岁男性被发现昏迷倒在楼梯底部，呼吸尚可，头皮血肿，GCS 8分。搭档建议摆恢复体位保护气道。恰当的处理是什么？

options.en: Place him in the recovery position as suggested
options.zh: 按建议摆放恢复体位

options.en: Apply spinal motion restriction with manual airway control, as the spine cannot be cleared
options.zh: 实施脊柱活动限制并手法管理气道，因无法排除脊柱损伤

options.en: Sit him upright to reduce intracranial pressure
options.zh: 让其坐直以降低颅内压

options.en: Walk-assist him to the stretcher once he rouses
options.zh: 待其苏醒后搀扶走向担架

questions.explanationEn: An unconscious patient with a mechanism for spinal injury cannot be assessed with NEXUS or Canadian C-Spine criteria — decreased LOC is itself a clinical indication for spinal motion restriction. Rolling him into a recovery position without stabilization risks cord injury; the airway is managed with manual maneuvers, suction, and adjuncts while SMR is maintained.
questions.explanationZh: 存在脊柱损伤机制的昏迷患者无法用NEXUS或加拿大颈椎准则排除损伤——意识下降本身就是脊柱活动限制的临床指征。未加固定就翻成恢复体位有脊髓损伤风险；应在维持脊柱固定的同时用手法、抽吸和辅助器械管理气道。

questions.questionEn: A 24-year-old male was in a low-speed parking-lot collision. He is alert, calm, and sober, with no midline cervical tenderness, no neurological deficit, and no painful distracting injury. He asks if he needs a collar. Based on NEXUS criteria, what is appropriate?
questions.questionZh: 一名24岁男性在停车场低速碰撞。患者清醒、平静、未饮酒，无颈椎正中压痛，无神经功能缺损，无引起注意力分散的疼痛性损伤。他询问是否需要颈托。根据NEXUS标准，恰当的做法是什么？

options.en: Apply full spinal motion restriction as a precaution
options.zh: 以防万一实施完全脊柱活动限制

options.en: Apply a collar only, without a spinal device
options.zh: 仅上颈托，不用脊柱装置

options.en: Spinal motion restriction is not indicated; no immobilization is required
options.zh: 无脊柱活动限制指征；无需固定

options.en: Transport prone to protect the cervical spine
options.zh: 俯卧位转运以保护颈椎

questions.explanationEn: BC directs following NEXUS and Canadian C-Spine guidelines. He meets all low-risk NEXUS criteria: no midline tenderness, no focal deficit, normal alertness, no intoxication, and no distracting injury. Spinal motion restriction is therefore not indicated.
questions.explanationZh: BC要求遵循NEXUS和加拿大颈椎准则。该患者符合NEXUS全部低危标准：无正中压痛、无局灶神经缺损、意识正常、未醉酒、无分散注意力的损伤。因此无脊柱活动限制指征。

questions.questionEn: A 78-year-old male fell down six stairs and complains of neck stiffness. He is alert with no neurological deficit. Your partner notes he seems fine and suggests skipping immobilization. Applying the Canadian C-Spine Rule, what is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名78岁男性从六级台阶跌落，主诉颈部僵硬。患者清醒，无神经功能缺损。搭档觉得他状态尚好，建议不做固定。应用加拿大颈椎准则，正确的做法是什么？

options.en: Apply spinal motion restriction; age 65 or older with a dangerous mechanism is high risk
options.zh: 实施脊柱活动限制；65岁及以上加危险机制属于高危

options.en: Clear the spine because he has no neurological deficit
options.zh: 因无神经功能缺损而排除脊柱损伤

options.en: Ask him to rotate his neck 45 degrees and clear him if successful
options.zh: 让其转颈45度，成功即排除损伤

options.en: Immobilize only if pain worsens during transport
options.zh: 仅在转运中疼痛加重时固定

questions.explanationEn: Under the Canadian C-Spine Rule, age 65 or older and a dangerous mechanism (such as a fall down stairs) are high-risk factors that mandate spinal motion restriction. Range-of-motion testing is only for patients with no high-risk factors.
questions.explanationZh: 根据加拿大颈椎准则，65岁及以上和危险受伤机制（如跌落楼梯）属于高危因素，必须实施脊柱活动限制。只有不存在高危因素的患者才可进行颈部活动度测试。

questions.questionEn: An 84-year-old female with advanced dementia fell from her bed. She cannot reliably answer questions and does not complain of neck pain, but grimaces when her neck is palpated. GCS is 13 (her baseline is unknown). Can her cervical spine be clinically cleared?
questions.questionZh: 一名84岁重度失智女性从床上跌落。她无法可靠回答问题，未主诉颈痛，但触诊颈部时表情痛苦。GCS 13分（基线不详）。能否临床排除其颈椎损伤？

options.en: Yes, because she does not complain of neck pain
options.zh: 能，因为她未主诉颈痛

options.en: Yes, because a fall from bed is a low-energy mechanism
options.zh: 能，因为从床上跌落是低能量机制

options.en: No; altered mentation makes clearance criteria unreliable, so apply spinal motion restriction
options.zh: 不能；意识状态异常使排除标准不可靠，应实施脊柱活动限制

options.en: No; all patients over 80 must be immobilized regardless of assessment
options.zh: 不能；80岁以上患者无论评估结果如何都必须固定

questions.explanationEn: NEXUS requires normal alertness and a reliable examination. Dementia with an unknown baseline and GCS 13 makes the assessment unreliable, and her age is itself a Canadian C-Spine high-risk factor. Spinal motion restriction should be applied.
questions.explanationZh: NEXUS要求意识正常且体检可靠。失智且基线不详、GCS 13分使评估不可靠，而她的年龄本身就是加拿大颈椎准则的高危因素。应实施脊柱活动限制。

questions.questionEn: An 8-year-old boy fell from a trampoline and has midline cervical tenderness. He is alert and cooperative. How should spinal motion restriction be carried out?
questions.questionZh: 一名8岁男孩从蹦床跌落，颈椎正中压痛。患儿清醒配合。应如何实施脊柱活动限制？

options.en: Manual stabilization, an appropriately sized hard collar, spinal device with foam blocks, securing the body without taping the head
options.zh: 手法固定、合适尺寸的硬质颈托、脊柱装置加泡沫固定块，固定躯体但不用胶带固定头部

options.en: An adult collar folded to fit, with the head taped to the board
options.zh: 折叠成人颈托凑合使用，并用胶带将头固定于板上

options.en: No collar; children's spines are too flexible to injure
options.zh: 不用颈托；儿童脊柱柔韧不易受伤

options.en: Sitting position with a soft collar only
options.zh: 坐位仅用软颈托

questions.explanationEn: Midline tenderness is a clinical indication for spinal motion restriction. The sequence is manual stabilization, hard collar, spinal immobilization device, foam rollers/blocks, and securing the body — with the explicit rule not to tape the head.
questions.explanationZh: 正中压痛是脊柱活动限制的临床指征。流程为手法固定、硬质颈托、脊柱固定装置、泡沫固定块并固定躯体——并明确规定不可用胶带固定头部。

questions.questionEn: A 13-year-old boy dove head-first into the shallow end of a pool. Bystanders pulled him out; he is alert, breathing, and complains of neck pain and arm tingling. What is the appropriate management?
questions.questionZh: 一名13岁男孩头朝下跳入泳池浅水区。旁观者将其拉出；患儿清醒、有呼吸，主诉颈痛和手臂麻刺感。恰当的处理是什么？

options.en: Sit him up and dry him off before assessment
options.zh: 评估前先让其坐起并擦干身体

options.en: Have him walk to the stretcher to assess motor function
options.zh: 让其走向担架以评估运动功能

options.en: Recovery position with warm blankets
options.zh: 恢复体位加保暖毛毯

options.en: Apply spinal motion restriction based on the mechanism and symptoms while managing the airway
options.zh: 根据受伤机制和症状实施脊柱活动限制，同时管理气道

questions.explanationEn: A shallow-water diving mechanism with neck pain and neurological symptoms mandates spinal motion restriction: manual stabilization, hard collar, spinal device, and foam blocks. Drowning guidelines also direct applying SMR as indicated by the mechanism of injury.
questions.explanationZh: 浅水跳水机制伴颈痛和神经症状必须实施脊柱活动限制：手法固定、硬质颈托、脊柱装置和泡沫固定块。溺水指南同样要求根据受伤机制实施脊柱活动限制。

questions.questionEn: A 42-year-old assault victim has a GCS of 10. How is this traumatic brain injury classified?
questions.questionZh: 一名42岁被袭击患者GCS 10分。该颅脑损伤如何分级？

options.en: Mild traumatic brain injury
options.zh: 轻度颅脑损伤

options.en: Moderate traumatic brain injury
options.zh: 中度颅脑损伤

options.en: Severe traumatic brain injury
options.zh: 重度颅脑损伤

options.en: Cannot be classified without pupil assessment
options.zh: 未评估瞳孔无法分级

questions.explanationEn: GCS 13 or higher indicates mild injury, GCS 9-12 suggests moderate injury, and GCS 8 or lower defines severe traumatic brain injury. A GCS of 10 falls in the moderate range.
questions.explanationZh: GCS≥13为轻度损伤，GCS 9-12提示中度损伤，GCS≤8定义为重度颅脑损伤。GCS 10分属于中度范围。

questions.questionEn: A 36-year-old cyclist struck by a car has a suspected TBI, GCS 12, SpO2 96%, BP 132/80. He is secured to the stretcher. How should he be positioned for transport?
questions.questionZh: 一名36岁骑车人被汽车撞伤，疑似颅脑损伤，GCS 12分，SpO2 96%，血压132/80。已固定于担架。转运时应如何摆放体位？

options.en: Flat supine to maximize cerebral perfusion
options.zh: 完全仰卧以最大化脑灌注

options.en: Head of the bed elevated to 30 degrees
options.zh: 床头抬高30度

options.en: Trendelenburg position to support blood pressure
options.zh: 头低足高位以维持血压

options.en: Left lateral recovery position
options.zh: 左侧恢复体位

questions.explanationEn: TBI interventions include elevating the head of the bed to 30 degrees, which assists venous drainage and helps manage intracranial pressure. Trendelenburg would worsen ICP, and the recovery position is not the default for a secured TBI patient maintaining his airway.
questions.explanationZh: 颅脑损伤的处置包括将床头抬高30度，以利静脉回流、帮助控制颅内压。头低足高位会加重颅内压，恢复体位也不是气道自主维持的颅脑损伤患者的默认体位。

questions.questionEn: A 28-year-old fell from a roof. GCS 8, respirations 8 and shallow, SpO2 88% on high-flow oxygen. What is the appropriate ventilation management?
questions.questionZh: 一名28岁患者从屋顶坠落。GCS 8分，呼吸8次/分且浅，高流量吸氧下SpO2 88%。恰当的通气管理是什么？

options.en: Continue the non-rebreather and reassess in 10 minutes
options.zh: 继续使用非再吸入面罩，10分钟后复评

options.en: Switch to nasal cannula to avoid gastric insufflation
options.zh: 改用鼻导管以避免胃胀气

options.en: Hyperventilate aggressively to lower intracranial pressure
options.zh: 积极过度通气以降低颅内压

options.en: Assist ventilations to keep the SpO2 at or above 94%
options.zh: 辅助通气使SpO2维持在94%及以上

questions.explanationEn: If a TBI patient has difficulty maintaining respirations, the guideline directs assisting ventilations while keeping SpO2 at 94% or greater. Passive oxygen cannot correct hypoventilation, and routine aggressive hyperventilation is not part of the BC TBI guideline.
questions.explanationZh: 若颅脑损伤患者呼吸维持困难，指南要求辅助通气并将SpO2维持在94%及以上。被动给氧无法纠正通气不足，常规积极过度通气也不属于BC颅脑损伤指南内容。

questions.questionEn: A 30-year-old was struck on the head with a bat. He has an isolated head injury, GCS 7, BP 100/60, HR 118. Your partner suggests TXA given the mechanism and vital signs. What is the correct decision?
questions.questionZh: 一名30岁男性头部被球棒击伤，单纯颅脑损伤，GCS 7分，血压100/60，心率118。搭档根据机制和生命体征建议使用TXA。正确的决定是什么？

options.en: Withhold TXA because it is contraindicated in isolated TBI
options.zh: 不给TXA，因其为单纯颅脑损伤的禁忌用药

options.en: Give TXA 2 g IV push over 1 minute
options.zh: TXA 2克静脉推注1分钟

options.en: Give half-dose TXA due to the head injury
options.zh: 因颅脑损伤给予半量TXA

options.en: Give TXA only after a fluid bolus
options.zh: 先输液后再给TXA

questions.explanationEn: TXA is explicitly contraindicated for isolated traumatic brain injuries in both the TBI guideline and the TXA monograph. Management focuses on oxygenation (SpO2 ≥ 94%), ventilation support, head elevation, and maintaining systolic BP above 120 mmHg.
questions.explanationZh: 颅脑损伤指南和TXA药物专论均明确规定：单纯颅脑损伤禁用TXA。处置重点是氧合（SpO2≥94%）、通气支持、抬高头部并将收缩压维持在120mmHg以上。

questions.questionEn: A 76-year-old male on the stretcher after a fall has a suspected TBI, GCS 11, SpO2 95%, systolic BP 108 mmHg. As a PCP, what does the blood pressure require you to do?
questions.questionZh: 一名76岁男性跌倒后疑似颅脑损伤，已在担架上，GCS 11分，SpO2 95%，收缩压108mmHg。作为PCP，该血压要求你做什么？

options.en: Nothing; a systolic of 108 is adequate for cerebral perfusion
options.zh: 无需处理；收缩压108足以维持脑灌注

options.en: Position him head-down to raise the blood pressure
options.zh: 头低位以升高血压

options.en: Obtain vascular access and administer fluid to maintain systolic BP above 120 mmHg
options.zh: 建立静脉通路并输液将收缩压维持在120mmHg以上

options.en: Administer TXA to support the blood pressure
options.zh: 给予TXA以支持血压

questions.explanationEn: Additional PCP interventions for TBI include maintaining systolic blood pressure above 120 mmHg; the IV runs TKVO only when the systolic is already above 120. At 108 mmHg, fluid administration is needed to reach the target and protect cerebral perfusion.
questions.explanationZh: PCP对颅脑损伤的附加处置包括将收缩压维持在120mmHg以上；只有收缩压已高于120时静脉通路才以TKVO维持。目前108mmHg，需要输液达标以保护脑灌注。

questions.questionEn: A 79-year-old female struck her head falling from a chair. GCS 13, confused. Blood glucose is 3.2 mmol/L. In the context of her suspected TBI, what should the PCP do about this reading?
questions.questionZh: 一名79岁女性从椅子上跌落撞到头部。GCS 13分，意识混乱。血糖3.2mmol/L。就其疑似颅脑损伤而言，PCP应如何处理该血糖值？

options.en: Correct the hypoglycemia to maintain a glucose of 4.0-8.0 mmol/L
options.zh: 纠正低血糖，将血糖维持在4.0-8.0mmol/L

options.en: Withhold glucose; hyperglycemia worsens brain injury
options.zh: 不给糖；高血糖会加重脑损伤

options.en: Recheck the glucose only after arrival at hospital
options.zh: 到院后再复测血糖

options.en: Give glucose only if she becomes unresponsive
options.zh: 仅在其失去反应时才给糖

questions.explanationEn: Additional PCP interventions for TBI include maintaining normal blood sugar levels of 4.0-8.0 mmol/L. Her glucose of 3.2 is below range and may itself be contributing to her confusion; it must be corrected, not observed.
questions.explanationZh: PCP对颅脑损伤的附加处置包括将血糖维持在4.0-8.0mmol/L的正常范围。她的血糖3.2低于该范围，本身可能就是意识混乱的原因之一，必须纠正而非观察。

questions.questionEn: A 6-year-old fell from a climbing frame and struck his head. He opens his eyes to voice, is confused, and localizes pain — GCS 9. How is his brain injury classified, and what oxygen saturation must be maintained?
questions.questionZh: 一名6岁男孩从攀爬架跌落撞到头。呼唤睁眼、言语混乱、疼痛定位——GCS 9分。其脑损伤如何分级？血氧饱和度应维持在多少？

options.en: Mild injury; SpO2 at or above 90%
options.zh: 轻度损伤；SpO2维持90%及以上

options.en: Severe injury; SpO2 at or above 92%
options.zh: 重度损伤；SpO2维持92%及以上

options.en: Moderate injury; SpO2 at or above 94%
options.zh: 中度损伤；SpO2维持94%及以上

options.en: Moderate injury; SpO2 at or above 88%
options.zh: 中度损伤；SpO2维持88%及以上

questions.explanationEn: A GCS between 9 and 12 is suggestive of a moderate traumatic brain injury. All TBI patients require adequate oxygenation with SpO2 maintained at 94% or greater, assisting ventilations if needed.
questions.explanationZh: GCS 9-12分提示中度颅脑损伤。所有颅脑损伤患者都需要充分氧合，SpO2维持在94%及以上，必要时辅助通气。

questions.questionEn: A 12-year-old struck by a car has a suspected TBI and is fully immobilized with a hard collar on a spinal device. GCS 11 and his face appears congested. What TBI-specific adjustment should be made?
questions.questionZh: 一名12岁被汽车撞伤的患儿疑似颅脑损伤，已用硬质颈托完全固定于脊柱装置。GCS 11分，面部充血。应做何种针对颅脑损伤的调整？

options.en: Remove the collar entirely since it raises intracranial pressure
options.zh: 完全拆除颈托，因其升高颅内压

options.en: Loosen the hard collar and elevate the head of the bed 30 degrees while maintaining immobilization
options.zh: 松开硬质颈托并将床头抬高30度，同时维持固定

options.en: Tighten the collar to improve venous drainage
options.zh: 收紧颈托以改善静脉回流

options.en: Place him head-down to improve cerebral perfusion
options.zh: 头低位以改善脑灌注

questions.explanationEn: TBI interventions include loosening the hard collar and elevating the head of the bed to 30 degrees. A tight collar impedes jugular venous drainage and can raise ICP; loosening it — while the head remains stabilized on the device — addresses this without abandoning spinal precautions.
questions.explanationZh: 颅脑损伤的处置包括松开硬质颈托并将床头抬高30度。过紧的颈托阻碍颈静脉回流、可升高颅内压；在头部仍固定于装置的前提下松开颈托，既能解决问题又不放弃脊柱保护。

questions.questionEn: A 25-year-old female spilled boiling water on her forearm two minutes ago. The skin is red and blistering. What is the correct initial burn care?
questions.questionZh: 一名25岁女性两分钟前将沸水洒在前臂上。皮肤发红起水疱。正确的初始烧伤处理是什么？

options.en: Apply ice packs directly to the burn
options.zh: 冰袋直接敷在烧伤处

options.en: Cover immediately with dry gauze without cooling
options.zh: 不降温立即用干纱布覆盖

options.en: Apply burn ointment and a loose bandage
options.zh: 涂烧伤药膏并松松包扎

options.en: Cool the burn with cool running water for 15-20 minutes
options.zh: 用凉的流动水冲淋烧伤处15-20分钟

questions.explanationEn: Burns should receive 15-20 minutes of cooling with cool (not cold) running water wherever possible; cooling is also an important analgesic strategy. Ice is not used, and dressing occurs only after cooling has finished, using sterile, nonstick, dry gauze.
questions.explanationZh: 烧伤应尽可能用凉（而非冰冷）的流动水降温15-20分钟；降温同时也是重要的镇痛手段。不可用冰，敷料应在降温结束后进行，使用无菌、不粘、干燥的纱布。

questions.questionEn: A 7-year-old pulled a pot of hot soup onto his chest. His parents held the area under cool running water for 10 minutes before you arrived. He is stable with superficial partial-thickness burns. How much additional cooling is required?
questions.questionZh: 一名7岁男孩将一锅热汤打翻在胸前。到达前父母已用凉水冲淋患处10分钟。患儿稳定，为浅二度烧伤。还需要额外降温多长时间？

options.en: None; bystander cooling does not count toward the total
options.zh: 无需再降温；旁观者降温不计入总时长

options.en: A full 20 minutes, restarting the clock on your arrival
options.zh: 到达后重新计时，再降温整整20分钟

options.en: At least 30 more minutes for pediatric burns
options.zh: 儿童烧伤至少再降温30分钟

options.en: Approximately 5-10 more minutes, to reach 15-20 minutes total
options.zh: 再降温约5-10分钟，使总时长达到15-20分钟

questions.explanationEn: The recommended 15-20 minutes of cooling is inclusive of any time bystanders have provided effective cooling measures. With 10 effective minutes done, another 5-10 minutes completes the target without over-cooling the child.
questions.explanationZh: 推荐的15-20分钟降温时间包含旁观者已实施的有效降温时间。已完成有效降温10分钟，再降5-10分钟即达标，避免患儿过度降温。

questions.questionEn: Using the adult Rule of Nines, a 40-year-old male has burns covering his entire left arm and the anterior trunk. What is the estimated body surface area burned?
questions.questionZh: 应用成人九分法，一名40岁男性整个左上肢和躯干前面烧伤。估计烧伤体表面积是多少？
questions.explanationEn: In the adult Rule of Nines, each entire arm is 9% and the anterior trunk is 18%, giving 9 + 18 = 27%. Calculating BSA is a required step in the primary survey of burn management.
questions.explanationZh: 成人九分法中，每侧整个上肢为9%，躯干前面为18%，合计9+18=27%。计算烧伤体表面积是烧伤处理初步评估的必要步骤。

questions.questionEn: A 70 kg male with 30% BSA burns is hypotensive at BP 84/50, HR 128. Vascular access is established. What is the correct PCP fluid therapy?
questions.questionZh: 一名70公斤男性烧伤面积30%，血压84/50，心率128。已建立静脉通路。PCP的正确补液方案是什么？

options.en: 250 mL bolus, repeated only if BP falls further
options.zh: 250毫升快速输注，血压进一步下降才重复

options.en: 4 L over the first hour per the Parkland formula
options.zh: 按Parkland公式第一小时输4升

options.en: 20 mL/kg (1,400 mL), to a maximum of 2 litres
options.zh: 20毫升/公斤（1400毫升），最多不超过2升

options.en: No fluid; burn patients receive fluid only in hospital
options.zh: 不补液；烧伤患者仅在医院补液

questions.explanationEn: For hypotensive burn patients, the PCP fluid bolus is 20 mL/kg to a maximum of 2 litres. For a 70 kg patient this is 1,400 mL. The Parkland formula is an in-hospital calculation, not the BC prehospital standard.
questions.explanationZh: 对低血压烧伤患者，PCP补液量为20毫升/公斤，最多2升。70公斤患者即1400毫升。Parkland公式是院内计算方法，不是BC院前标准。

questions.questionEn: A 45-year-old male escaped a house fire. He has facial burns, singed nasal hairs, a hoarse voice, and increasing shortness of breath. SpO2 93%. What is the priority intervention?
questions.questionZh: 一名45岁男性从住宅火灾中逃出。面部烧伤、鼻毛烧焦、声音嘶哑、呼吸困难逐渐加重。SpO2 93%。优先处置是什么？

options.en: Apply high-flow oxygen and initiate transport for suspected inhalation injury
options.zh: 给予高流量吸氧并因疑似吸入性损伤立即转运

options.en: Administer Entonox for pain before moving him
options.zh: 搬动前先给Entonox镇痛

options.en: Complete 20 minutes of facial cooling before leaving scene
options.zh: 离开现场前完成20分钟面部降温

options.en: Give oral acetaminophen and reassess in 15 minutes
options.zh: 口服对乙酰氨基酚并15分钟后复评

questions.explanationEn: Hoarseness, singed nasal hairs, and facial burns signal inhalation injury with impending airway compromise. The guideline directs high-flow oxygen for suspected inhalation injury or shortness of breath. Entonox is contraindicated in inhalation injury, and prolonged scene cooling must not delay conveyance of a patient with life-threatening features.
questions.explanationZh: 声音嘶哑、鼻毛烧焦和面部烧伤提示吸入性损伤及气道危象。指南要求对疑似吸入性损伤或呼吸困难给予高流量吸氧。吸入性损伤禁用Entonox，对有危及生命表现的患者也不应因现场降温延误转运。

questions.questionEn: A 72-year-old female burned her hand and forearm on a stove. Cooling has been completed and she remains stable. How should the burn now be dressed?
questions.questionZh: 一名72岁女性手和前臂被炉灶烧伤。降温已完成，病情稳定。现在应如何包扎烧伤创面？

options.en: Wet gauze soaked in saline, changed every 10 minutes
options.zh: 生理盐水浸湿纱布，每10分钟更换

options.en: Antibiotic ointment under an occlusive film
options.zh: 抗生素药膏外覆封闭膜

options.en: Sterile, nonstick, dry gauze
options.zh: 无菌、不粘、干燥的纱布

options.en: Ice packs secured with an elastic bandage
options.zh: 用弹性绷带固定冰袋

questions.explanationEn: Once cooling has finished, the treatment component directs dressing the wound with sterile, nonstick, dry gauze. Continuing wet coverings after the cooling period promotes hypothermia, particularly in the elderly, and ointments are not part of prehospital burn care.
questions.explanationZh: 降温结束后，治疗环节要求用无菌、不粘、干燥的纱布覆盖创面。降温期结束后继续湿敷会导致体温过低，老年人尤甚；药膏也不属于院前烧伤处理。

questions.questionEn: A 77-year-old female has 25% BSA scald burns. She has received 20 minutes of cooling and is now shivering with a temperature of 35.8°C. Her daughter asks you to keep rinsing the burns for pain relief. What is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名77岁女性烫伤面积25%。已降温20分钟，现在寒战，体温35.8°C。其女儿请你继续冲洗烧伤处以缓解疼痛。正确的做法是什么？

options.en: Stop cooling, apply dry sterile dressings, and keep her warm for transport
options.zh: 停止降温，覆盖干燥无菌敷料，保暖转运

options.en: Continue cooling until she is pain-free
options.zh: 持续降温直至疼痛完全缓解

options.en: Alternate 10 minutes of cooling with 5 minutes of warming
options.zh: 降温10分钟与复温5分钟交替进行

options.en: Immerse the burned areas in cold water en route
options.zh: 转运途中将烧伤部位浸入冷水

questions.explanationEn: Cooling is limited to 15-20 minutes; she has completed it and is already showing hypothermia (shivering, 35.8°C). Large-BSA burn patients lose heat rapidly, so cooling must stop, dry sterile nonstick dressings applied, and heat loss prevented. Analgesia should be managed pharmacologically instead.
questions.explanationZh: 降温限定为15-20分钟；她已完成且已出现体温过低表现（寒战、35.8°C）。大面积烧伤患者散热极快，必须停止降温、覆盖干燥无菌不粘敷料并防止热量丢失。镇痛应改用药物手段。

questions.questionEn: A 2-year-old pulled a cup of hot tea onto her thigh 3 minutes ago. Her parents cooled the area for about 5 minutes under the tap. She is alert and crying. What is the appropriate continued burn care?
questions.questionZh: 一名2岁女童3分钟前将一杯热茶打翻在大腿上。父母已在水龙头下降温约5分钟。患儿清醒哭闹。恰当的后续烧伤处理是什么？

options.en: Immerse her whole body in a cool bath for 20 minutes
options.zh: 将其全身浸入凉水浴20分钟

options.en: Stop cooling now to prevent hypothermia in a toddler
options.zh: 幼儿易失温，现在就停止降温

options.en: Apply ice wrapped in a towel for 10 minutes
options.zh: 毛巾包冰敷10分钟

options.en: Continue cool running water to reach 15-20 minutes total while monitoring her temperature
options.zh: 继续凉水冲淋至总计15-20分钟，同时监测体温

questions.explanationEn: Burns receive 15-20 minutes of cooling inclusive of bystander cooling, so roughly 10-15 more minutes are needed. Cooling is localized with cool running water — not whole-body immersion or ice — and small children must be monitored for hypothermia throughout.
questions.explanationZh: 烧伤降温总计15-20分钟（含旁观者降温时间），故还需约10-15分钟。降温应用凉的流动水局部进行——不是全身浸泡也不是冰敷——且全程须监测幼儿体温防止失温。

questions.questionEn: A 3-week-old was bathed in water that was too hot and has reddened, blistering skin over both lower legs. The infant is crying vigorously. What is the appropriate management?
questions.questionZh: 一名3周大的婴儿洗澡水过热，双小腿皮肤发红起疱。婴儿哭声有力。恰当的处理是什么？

options.en: Cool the legs with cool (not cold) water for 15-20 minutes while keeping the rest of the infant warm, then apply sterile nonstick dry dressings
options.zh: 用凉（非冰冷）水冲淋双腿15-20分钟，同时为婴儿其余部位保暖，随后覆盖无菌不粘干敷料

options.en: Skip cooling entirely; neonates must never have burns cooled
options.zh: 完全不降温；新生儿烧伤绝不可降温

options.en: Immerse the infant in a basin of cold water for 15 minutes
options.zh: 将婴儿浸入冷水盆中15分钟

options.en: Apply moist dressings and re-wet them throughout transport
options.zh: 覆盖湿敷料并在转运全程反复浸湿

questions.explanationEn: Burn cooling for 15-20 minutes with cool (not cold) water applies at all ages, but a neonate's large surface-to-mass ratio demands strict protection against hypothermia: cool only the burned area, keep the rest of the body warm, and after cooling dress with sterile, nonstick, dry gauze.
questions.explanationZh: 用凉（非冰冷）水降温15-20分钟适用于所有年龄，但新生儿体表面积与体重比大，必须严防失温：只对烧伤部位降温，其余部位保暖，降温结束后用无菌、不粘、干燥纱布覆盖。

questions.questionEn: A 9-year-old touched an exposed live wire in the garage. The power has been confirmed off. He is alert with a small entry wound on his palm and an exit wound on his knee. What does the electrical contact guideline direct?
questions.questionZh: 一名9岁男孩在车库触碰裸露带电电线。电源已确认切断。患儿清醒，手掌有小的入口伤，膝部有出口伤。电击伤指南要求如何处理？

options.en: Treat only the visible wounds; internal injury is unlikely in children
options.zh: 仅处理可见伤口；儿童不易有内部损伤

options.en: Flush and decontaminate the wounds with sterile saline, estimate BSA with burn charts, identify current type and contact duration, and transport
options.zh: 用无菌生理盐水冲洗净化伤口，用烧伤图表估算面积，了解电流类型和接触时长，并转运

options.en: Apply ice directly to both wounds and discharge to parents
options.zh: 两处伤口直接冰敷后交由父母照顾

options.en: Cool the wounds continuously for 40 minutes before transport
options.zh: 转运前持续降温40分钟

questions.explanationEn: For electrical contact, the guideline directs flushing and decontaminating affected areas with sterile saline, estimating total surface area using burn estimation charts, identifying the type of current and duration of contact, and initiating conveyance. Cooling must not exceed 15-20 minutes including decontamination time.
questions.explanationZh: 对电击伤，指南要求用无菌生理盐水冲洗净化患处，用烧伤估算图表估算面积，了解电流类型和接触时长，并开始转运。包括净化时间在内，降温不得超过15-20分钟。

questions.questionEn: You arrive at a single-vehicle MVC where a power line has fallen across the car. The 38-year-old driver is slumped inside, apparently unconscious. Bystanders urge you to pull him out. What must you do?
questions.questionZh: 你到达一起单车事故现场，一根电线倒落在车上。38岁司机瘫坐车内，似已昏迷。旁观者催促你把他拉出来。你必须怎么做？

options.en: Use a dry wooden pole to lift the line off the car
options.zh: 用干燥木杆将电线挑离车辆

options.en: Approach quickly wearing rubber gloves
options.zh: 戴橡胶手套快速接近

options.en: Instruct the driver to jump clear while you keep back
options.zh: 你保持距离，指挥司机跳车脱离

options.en: Stay clear and do not approach until qualified personnel have deemed the scene safe
options.zh: 保持距离，在专业人员确认现场安全前不得接近

questions.explanationEn: Paramedic safety is critical: do not approach electrical sources or downed power lines until qualified personnel have deemed the scene safe. Improvised attempts to move energized lines kill rescuers; patient care begins only after the scene is declared safe.
questions.explanationZh: 急救人员安全至关重要：在专业人员确认现场安全之前，不得接近电源或倒落的电线。自行挪动带电线路会导致施救者死亡；只有现场宣布安全后才能开始救治。

questions.questionEn: A 27-year-old male was stabbed in the right chest. There is a bubbling wound that makes a sucking sound with each breath. How should this wound be managed?
questions.questionZh: 一名27岁男性右胸被刺伤。伤口有气泡冒出，随呼吸发出吸吮声。该伤口应如何处理？

options.en: Seal it with a three-sided occlusive dressing or commercial chest seal
options.zh: 用三边封闭敷料或商用胸腔封闭贴封闭伤口

options.en: Pack the wound tightly with hemostatic gauze
options.zh: 用止血纱布紧密填塞伤口

options.en: Cover it with a fully sealed occlusive dressing taped on all four sides
options.zh: 用四边全部封死的封闭敷料覆盖

options.en: Leave it open to allow air to escape freely
options.zh: 敞开伤口让空气自由排出

questions.explanationEn: An open chest wound is sealed with a three-sided occlusive dressing or a commercial chest seal, then monitored closely for development of a tension pneumothorax. Chest wounds must never be packed, and sealing all four sides without a vent increases tension risk.
questions.explanationZh: 开放性胸部伤口应用三边封闭敷料或商用胸腔封闭贴封闭，随后密切监测张力性气胸的发生。胸部伤口绝不可填塞，四边全封死且无排气口会增加张力性气胸风险。

questions.questionEn: Ten minutes after you sealed a stab wound to the left chest, the 33-year-old patient develops severe respiratory distress, absent breath sounds on the left, and BP falls to 78/50. What should you do immediately?
questions.questionZh: 你封闭一名33岁患者左胸刺伤伤口10分钟后，患者出现严重呼吸窘迫，左侧呼吸音消失，血压降至78/50。你应立即做什么？

options.en: Reinforce the seal with additional tape
options.zh: 用更多胶带加固封闭敷料

options.en: Increase the oxygen flow and continue transport unchanged
options.zh: 加大氧流量，转运方式不变

options.en: Lift or vent the occlusive dressing to relieve the suspected tension pneumothorax
options.zh: 掀开或放气封闭敷料以解除疑似张力性气胸

options.en: Begin chest compressions in anticipation of arrest
options.zh: 预判心搏骤停而开始胸外按压

questions.explanationEn: After sealing an open chest wound, the guideline directs monitoring closely for a tension pneumothorax and relieving it if necessary. Worsening distress, unilateral absent breath sounds, and hypotension after sealing indicate tension physiology; venting or briefly lifting the seal lets trapped air escape.
questions.explanationZh: 封闭开放性胸部伤口后，指南要求密切监测张力性气胸并在必要时予以解除。封闭后呼吸窘迫加重、单侧呼吸音消失和低血压提示张力性气胸；掀开或放气封闭敷料可让积聚的气体排出。

questions.questionEn: According to BC guidelines, how is a flail chest segment stabilized in the prehospital setting?
questions.questionZh: 根据BC指南，院前环境下应如何固定连枷胸？

options.en: Manually stabilize the flail segment
options.zh: 手法固定连枷段

options.en: Tape a sandbag firmly over the segment
options.zh: 用胶带将沙袋牢牢固定在连枷段上

options.en: Wrap the chest circumferentially with elastic bandages
options.zh: 用弹性绷带环形包扎胸廓

options.en: Position the patient on the uninjured side only
options.zh: 仅让患者伤侧朝上侧卧

questions.explanationEn: The guideline states the flail chest is stabilized MANUALLY. Circumferential wrapping and heavy objects restrict ventilation and worsen hypoxia; oxygenation and ventilation are assisted as necessary.
questions.explanationZh: 指南规定连枷胸应以手法固定。环形包扎和重物压迫会限制通气、加重缺氧；必要时应辅助氧合与通气。

questions.questionEn: A 74-year-old male fell against a workbench. A segment of his right chest moves paradoxically with breathing, SpO2 is 89%, and he is working hard to breathe. What is the appropriate management?
questions.questionZh: 一名74岁男性撞到工作台。右胸一段胸壁随呼吸出现反常运动，SpO2 89%，呼吸费力。恰当的处理是什么？

options.en: Encourage deep breathing and coughing to prevent atelectasis
options.zh: 鼓励深呼吸和咳嗽以防肺不张

options.en: Strap the chest tightly to splint the segment
options.zh: 紧紧捆扎胸廓以固定该段胸壁

options.en: Manually stabilize the flail segment and assist oxygenation and ventilation as necessary
options.zh: 手法固定连枷段，必要时辅助氧合与通气

options.en: Position him flail-side up and withhold oxygen
options.zh: 伤侧朝上侧卧并不给氧

questions.explanationEn: Paradoxical movement indicates a flail chest. The guideline directs manual stabilization and assisting oxygenation and ventilation if necessary. In an elderly patient with SpO2 of 89% and respiratory fatigue, ventilatory support must not be delayed.
questions.explanationZh: 反常呼吸运动提示连枷胸。指南要求手法固定，必要时辅助氧合与通气。老年患者SpO2仅89%且呼吸疲劳，通气支持不可延误。

questions.questionEn: A 69-year-old male was crushed against a loading dock by a trailer 45 minutes ago. He has right-sided chest wall bruising, HR 122, BP 86/58, cool pale skin. You are en route with vascular access established. What additional PCP intervention is indicated?
questions.questionZh: 一名69岁男性45分钟前被拖车挤压在装卸台上。右侧胸壁瘀伤，心率122，血压86/58，皮肤苍白湿冷。转运途中已建立静脉通路。还应给予哪项PCP处置？

options.en: TXA 1 g IM into the deltoid
options.zh: TXA 1克三角肌肌注

options.en: TXA 2 g (2,000 mg) IV push over 1 minute
options.zh: TXA 2克（2000毫克）静脉推注1分钟

options.en: TXA is contraindicated in chest trauma
options.zh: 胸部创伤禁用TXA

options.en: Aspirin 160 mg PO to prevent clot formation
options.zh: 口服阿司匹林160毫克预防血栓形成

questions.explanationEn: Chest trauma PCP interventions en route include vascular access and TXA if indicated. He shows signs of shock with a mechanism suggestive of ongoing bleeding, within 3 hours of injury, and is over 12 with no isolated TBI — so TXA 2 g IV push over 1 minute is given.
questions.explanationZh: 胸部创伤的PCP转运途中处置包括静脉通路和符合指征时给予TXA。他有休克表现、机制提示持续出血、受伤在3小时内、年龄超过12岁且非单纯颅脑损伤——因此给予TXA 2克静脉推注1分钟。

questions.questionEn: A 71-year-old female has severe pain from suspected rib fractures after a fall. She requests "the gas she got last time." On auscultation, breath sounds are decreased on the right. Why must Entonox be withheld?
questions.questionZh: 一名71岁女性跌倒后疑似肋骨骨折，疼痛剧烈。她要求使用"上次用过的镇痛气体"。听诊发现右侧呼吸音减弱。为什么必须停用Entonox？

options.en: Entonox is ineffective for musculoskeletal pain
options.zh: Entonox对肌肉骨骼疼痛无效

options.en: Her age places her above the Entonox age limit
options.zh: 她的年龄超过Entonox年龄上限

options.en: Nitrous oxide requires a physician order in trauma
options.zh: 创伤患者使用氧化亚氮需医生医嘱

options.en: Decreased breath sounds suggest a pneumothorax, which is a contraindication
options.zh: 呼吸音减弱提示气胸，属于禁忌证

questions.explanationEn: Pneumothorax is an absolute contraindication to Entonox: nitrous oxide diffuses into air-filled spaces and can expand a pneumothorax into tension physiology. Rib fractures with unilateral decreased breath sounds must be assumed to have a pneumothorax until proven otherwise.
questions.explanationZh: 气胸是Entonox的绝对禁忌证：氧化亚氮会弥散进入含气腔隙，可使气胸扩大甚至发展为张力性气胸。肋骨骨折伴单侧呼吸音减弱者应默认存在气胸，除非证实排除。

questions.questionEn: An 11-year-old boy fell from a tree and a broken branch is impaled in his right anterior chest. He is alert, breathing rapidly, SpO2 94%. How should the branch be managed?
questions.questionZh: 一名11岁男孩从树上跌落，一根断枝刺入右前胸。患儿清醒，呼吸急促，SpO2 94%。应如何处理该断枝？

options.en: Remove it quickly and seal the wound with a chest seal
options.zh: 迅速拔出并用胸腔封闭贴封闭伤口

options.en: Rock it gently to assess the depth of penetration
options.zh: 轻轻晃动以评估刺入深度

options.en: Remove it only if transport exceeds 20 minutes
options.zh: 仅当转运超过20分钟时才拔出

options.en: Stabilize it in place with bulky dressings and transport without removing it
options.zh: 用厚敷料原位固定，不拔出并转运

questions.explanationEn: Embedded objects are stabilized in place unless they impair the airway. An impaled chest object may be tamponading vessels or lung; removal in the field can trigger uncontrollable hemorrhage or an open pneumothorax. Stabilize, monitor breathing closely, and transport.
questions.explanationZh: 嵌入物除危及气道外均应原位固定。胸部刺入物可能正压迫血管或肺组织起填塞作用；现场拔出可导致无法控制的出血或开放性气胸。应固定、密切监测呼吸并转运。

questions.questionEn: A 45-year-old hiker rescued from a snowstorm has a core temperature of 30°C. How is his hypothermia classified?
questions.questionZh: 一名45岁徒步者从暴风雪中获救，核心体温30°C。其低体温如何分级？

options.en: Mild hypothermia
options.zh: 轻度低体温

options.en: Moderate hypothermia
options.zh: 中度低体温

options.en: Severe hypothermia
options.zh: 重度低体温

options.en: Profound hypothermia
options.zh: 极重度低体温

questions.explanationEn: Mild hypothermia is a core temperature above 32°C and below 35°C; moderate is 28-32°C; severe is below 28°C. At 30°C he is moderately hypothermic, and both mild and moderate categories receive active rewarming.
questions.explanationZh: 轻度低体温为核心体温高于32°C且低于35°C；中度为28-32°C；重度为低于28°C。30°C属中度低体温，轻度和中度均应主动复温。

questions.questionEn: A 39-year-old man pulled from a crevasse has a core temperature of 26°C. He is breathing slowly with a weak pulse. What does the guideline direct for rewarming?
questions.questionZh: 一名39岁男性从冰裂缝中被救出，核心体温26°C。呼吸缓慢，脉搏微弱。指南对复温有何要求？

options.en: Active rewarming with hot packs to the trunk
options.zh: 躯干放置热敷袋主动复温

options.en: Mild activity and warm oral fluids
options.zh: 轻度活动并饮用温热液体

options.en: Do not actively rewarm; insulate, heat the ambulance to 30°C, and avoid rough handling
options.zh: 不主动复温；做好隔热保温，救护车加热至30°C，避免粗暴搬动

options.en: Immersion rewarming in warm water before transport
options.zh: 转运前温水浸泡复温

questions.explanationEn: Severe hypothermia (below 28°C) must not be actively rewarmed in the field. The patient is insulated to prevent further heat loss, the ambulance is heated to 30°C, and rough handling is avoided because the cold myocardium is prone to ventricular fibrillation.
questions.explanationZh: 重度低体温（低于28°C）在院前不可主动复温。应做好隔热防止热量继续丢失，将救护车加热至30°C，并避免粗暴搬动，因为低温心肌极易发生室颤。

questions.questionEn: A severely hypothermic 50-year-old is in cardiac arrest. The AED has delivered three shocks with no change. What does the BC guideline direct next?
questions.questionZh: 一名重度低体温的50岁患者心搏骤停。AED已电击三次无效。BC指南要求接下来怎么做？

options.en: Continue CPR and rapid transport without pausing for further analysis or shocks
options.zh: 继续心肺复苏并快速转运，不再为分析或电击而暂停

options.en: Continue cycles of analysis and shocks every 2 minutes
options.zh: 每2分钟继续分析和电击循环

options.en: Stop resuscitation; three failed shocks indicate futility
options.zh: 终止复苏；三次电击无效表明无望

options.en: Withhold CPR until the patient is rewarmed above 30°C
options.zh: 复温至30°C以上前暂缓心肺复苏

questions.explanationEn: In hypothermic cardiac arrest, the AED is applied and defibrillation attempted up to three times if indicated; after three defibrillations, CPR is not paused for analyzing or shocks, and the patient is transported rapidly with continuous CPR. Hypothermic patients are not dead until warm and dead.
questions.explanationZh: 低体温心搏骤停时应用AED并按指征最多电击三次；三次电击后不再为分析或电击暂停心肺复苏，应持续按压并快速转运。低体温患者"未复温不算死亡"。

questions.questionEn: You find an unresponsive 47-year-old who spent the night outdoors at -5°C. He appears lifeless. How long should you take to assess for a pulse before starting CPR?
questions.questionZh: 你发现一名47岁男性在零下5°C户外过夜后无反应，看似没有生命迹象。开始心肺复苏前应用多长时间判断脉搏？

options.en: 5 seconds, to minimize delay to compressions
options.zh: 5秒，尽量减少按压延迟

options.en: No pulse check is needed in the cold
options.zh: 低温环境无需判断脉搏

options.en: Up to 30-45 seconds
A full 2 minutes with a Doppler
options.zh: 用多普勒整整测2分钟

questions.explanationEn: In the severely hypothermic patient, take up to 30-45 seconds to determine pulselessness. Severe hypothermia produces profound bradycardia with a barely detectable pulse, and unnecessary compressions on a beating cold heart can precipitate ventricular fibrillation.
questions.explanationZh: 对重度低体温患者，应用最长30-45秒判断是否无脉。重度低体温可导致极度心动过缓、脉搏难以触及，对仍在跳动的低温心脏进行不必要的按压可诱发室颤。

questions.questionEn: An 84-year-old female was found on her bathroom floor after a night without heating. She is conscious, shivering, in wet clothing, with a temperature of 31°C. What is the appropriate management?
questions.questionZh: 一名84岁女性在无暖气的夜晚后被发现躺在浴室地板上。意识清醒，寒战，衣物潮湿，体温31°C。恰当的处理是什么？

options.en: Remove wet clothing and actively rewarm with warm blankets, towel-wrapped hot packs, and an ambulance preheated to 30°C
options.zh: 脱去湿冷衣物，用暖毯、毛巾包裹的热敷袋主动复温，救护车预热至30°C

options.en: Leave the wet clothing on to avoid exposure and cover with one sheet
options.zh: 为避免暴露不脱湿衣，仅盖一条床单

options.en: Insulate only, as active rewarming is prohibited in the elderly
options.zh: 仅做隔热保温，老年人禁止主动复温

options.en: Apply hot packs directly against her bare skin for faster rewarming
options.zh: 热敷袋直接贴皮肤以加快复温

questions.explanationEn: At 31°C she has moderate hypothermia (28-32°C), which — like mild hypothermia — is actively rewarmed: remove wet and cold clothing, use warm blankets and hot packs wrapped in towels, and preheat the ambulance interior to 30°C. Only severe hypothermia (below 28°C) precludes active rewarming.
questions.explanationZh: 体温31°C属中度低体温（28-32°C），与轻度一样应主动复温：脱去湿冷衣物，使用暖毯和毛巾包裹的热敷袋，救护车内预热至30°C。只有重度低体温（低于28°C）才禁止主动复温。

questions.questionEn: A 79-year-old male found in a snowbank has a core temperature of 27°C, GCS 12, and a slow irregular pulse. Your partner wants him to walk to the stretcher to "get his circulation going." Why must this be refused?
questions.questionZh: 一名79岁男性被发现困在雪堆中，核心体温27°C，GCS 12分，脉搏缓慢不规则。搭档想让他自己走向担架以"促进血液循环"。为什么必须拒绝？

options.en: Walking is acceptable but only with two-person assistance
options.zh: 可以行走，但须两人搀扶

options.en: Exertion helps rewarming and should actually be encouraged
options.zh: 活动有助复温，其实应该鼓励

options.en: He should walk only after drinking something warm
options.zh: 喝些热饮后才可以行走

options.en: At below 28°C, exertion and rough handling can precipitate cardiac arrest; he must be moved gently and insulated without active rewarming
options.zh: 体温低于28°C时，活动和粗暴搬动可诱发心搏骤停；必须轻柔搬动、隔热保温且不主动复温

questions.explanationEn: Mild activity is an option only in mild-to-moderate hypothermia. At 27°C this is severe hypothermia: the irritable cold myocardium can fibrillate with exertion or rough handling. He must be handled gently, insulated against further heat loss, and not actively rewarmed in the field.
questions.explanationZh: 轻度活动仅适用于轻中度低体温。27°C属重度低体温：应激的低温心肌在用力或粗暴搬动时可发生室颤。必须轻柔搬动、隔热防止热量继续丢失，且院前不主动复温。

questions.questionEn: During a heat wave, a 76-year-old male is found confused in his non-air-conditioned apartment. Skin is hot and dry, HR 128, BP 98/60, GCS 13. Besides initiating cooling, what must the initial vital signs include?
questions.questionZh: 热浪期间，一名76岁男性被发现在无空调的公寓内意识混乱。皮肤干热，心率128，血压98/60，GCS 13分。除开始降温外，初始生命体征还必须包括什么？

options.en: A 12-lead ECG before any cooling
options.zh: 降温前先做12导联心电图

options.en: A blood glucose measurement, because his LOC is decreased
options.zh: 血糖测量，因其意识水平下降

options.en: Orthostatic vital signs standing and lying
options.zh: 站立位与卧位的体位性生命体征

options.en: A rectal temperature every 5 minutes
options.zh: 每5分钟测一次直肠温度

questions.explanationEn: The heat exhaustion/heatstroke guideline states initial vital signs must include a blood glucose measurement if there is decreased LOC. Hypoglycemia can mimic or complicate heatstroke and must not be missed while cooling proceeds.
questions.explanationZh: 中暑指南规定：若患者意识水平下降，初始生命体征必须包括血糖测量。低血糖可与热射病表现相似或并存，降温的同时绝不能漏诊。

questions.questionEn: A 34-year-old roofer collapsed in 38°C heat. He is confused with hot, flushed skin, HR 132, BP 102/64. You have moved him to a cool area and removed his clothing. When should transport begin?
questions.questionZh: 一名34岁屋顶工人在38°C高温下晕倒。意识混乱，皮肤发烫潮红，心率132，血压102/64。你已将其移至阴凉处并脱去衣物。何时开始转运？

options.en: Immediately; cooling can wait until arrival at hospital
options.zh: 立即转运；降温可等到院后进行

options.en: After a minimum of 10 minutes of aggressive cooling, continuing the most aggressive cooling available during transport
options.zh: 至少积极降温10分钟后，转运途中继续采用可用的最积极降温手段

options.en: Only after his temperature has fully normalized on scene
options.zh: 待现场体温完全恢复正常后

options.en: After giving two litres of oral rehydration fluid
options.zh: 口服两升补液后

questions.explanationEn: Cooling efforts continue for a minimum of 10 minutes prior to beginning conveyance: cold wet towels to head, torso, and thighs, feet and legs immersed in ice water, and convective cooling. The most aggressive cooling available continues during transport until treatment endpoints are reached.
questions.explanationZh: 开始转运前应持续积极降温至少10分钟：头部、躯干和大腿敷冷湿毛巾，双足和下肢浸入冰水，同时进行对流降温。转运途中继续采用可用的最积极降温方式，直至达到治疗终点。

questions.questionEn: An 81-year-old female with heat exhaustion has been cooling for 15 minutes. She is alert now but has a dry tongue, poor skin turgor, HR 118, BP 92/58. As a PCP, what additional intervention should be considered?
questions.questionZh: 一名81岁中暑衰竭女性已降温15分钟。现意识清醒，但舌面干燥、皮肤弹性差，心率118，血压92/58。作为PCP，还应考虑哪项处置？

options.en: Oral salt tablets to replace sodium losses
options.zh: 口服盐片补充钠丢失

options.en: Dimenhydrinate to prevent heat-related nausea
options.zh: 给予茶苯海明预防中暑相关恶心

options.en: Withholding all fluids until hospital assessment
options.zh: 到院评估前禁止一切补液

options.en: Vascular access and fluid replacement for her signs of dehydration
options.zh: 建立静脉通路，针对脱水表现进行补液

questions.explanationEn: The additional PCP intervention for heat emergencies is to consider the need for fluid replacement in patients with signs and symptoms of dehydration. Dry mucous membranes, poor turgor, tachycardia, and borderline hypotension in an elderly patient are exactly those signs.
questions.explanationZh: 中暑的PCP附加处置是：对有脱水症状体征的患者考虑补液。老年患者出现黏膜干燥、皮肤弹性差、心动过速和临界低血压，正是这些表现。

questions.questionEn: A 4-year-old was found unresponsive in a locked car on a hot day. Skin is hot and flushed, RR 32, HR 158. After moving her to the air-conditioned ambulance, what is the priority?
questions.questionZh: 炎热天气中，一名4岁女童被发现困在上锁的车内且无反应。皮肤发烫潮红，呼吸32次/分，心率158。移入有空调的救护车后，优先处置是什么？

options.en: Remove all clothing and begin aggressive cooling with cold wet towels to the head, torso, and thighs with the AC on maximum
options.zh: 脱去全部衣物，头部、躯干和大腿敷冷湿毛巾积极降温，空调开至最大冷风

options.en: Wrap her in a blanket to prevent shivering
options.zh: 用毛毯包裹以防寒战

options.en: Give cold water to drink before any external cooling
options.zh: 外部降温前先喂冷水

options.en: Transport immediately without on-scene cooling
options.zh: 不做现场降温立即转运

questions.explanationEn: Heatstroke management directs removing all clothing, convective cooling with air conditioning on maximum cold, and applying cold wet towels to the head, torso, and thighs. Cooling continues a minimum of 10 minutes before conveyance and aggressively during transport. An unresponsive child cannot safely take oral fluids.
questions.explanationZh: 热射病处理要求脱去全部衣物，空调最大冷风对流降温，头部、躯干和大腿敷冷湿毛巾。转运前至少降温10分钟，途中继续积极降温。无反应的患儿不能安全口服液体。

questions.questionEn: A 7-year-old boy was pulled from a lake after going under briefly. He is alert, coughing, SpO2 95%, and shivering in wet clothes. There was no diving or trauma. How should he be managed?
questions.questionZh: 一名7岁男孩短暂沉入湖水后被救起。意识清醒，咳嗽，SpO2 95%，穿着湿衣寒战。无跳水或外伤史。应如何处理？

options.en: Perform abdominal thrusts to expel aspirated water
options.zh: 做腹部冲击以排出吸入的水

options.en: Have him run around to warm up while awaiting transport
options.zh: 等待转运期间让他跑动取暖

options.en: Position him sitting up, remove wet clothing, dry him, keep him at rest, and transport
options.zh: 取坐位，脱去湿衣并擦干，保持安静休息并转运

options.en: Refuse transport since he is now asymptomatic
options.zh: 因其已无症状而无需转运

questions.explanationEn: Drowning management directs keeping the patient at rest, positioning sitting up, removing wet clothing and drying the patient, avoiding rough handling, and maintaining body temperature. Abdominal thrusts to remove water are not part of care, and drowning patients require transport because deterioration can be delayed.
questions.explanationZh: 溺水处理要求让患者安静休息、取坐位、脱去湿衣并擦干、避免粗暴搬动、维持体温。腹部冲击排水不属于规范处置；溺水患者可能延迟恶化，必须转运。

questions.questionEn: A 3-week-old infant was found submerged in a bathtub. On assessment the infant is unresponsive and apneic with a slow brachial pulse. What is the immediate action?
questions.questionZh: 一名3周大的婴儿被发现沉入浴缸水中。评估发现婴儿无反应、无呼吸，肱动脉搏动缓慢。应立即采取什么措施？

options.en: Immediately commence resuscitation with positive pressure ventilations according to the appropriate guideline
options.zh: 按相应指南立即开始复苏，给予正压通气

options.en: Dry and stimulate for 5 minutes before any ventilation
options.zh: 先擦干和刺激5分钟再考虑通气

options.en: Perform back blows to clear water from the lungs
options.zh: 拍背以清除肺内的水

options.en: Warm the infant fully before starting resuscitation
options.zh: 完全复温后再开始复苏

questions.explanationEn: Drowning patients in respiratory arrest must have resuscitation commenced immediately according to the appropriate guideline — for an apneic infant with bradycardia this means immediate positive pressure ventilations. Hypoxia is the driver of drowning arrest; ventilation cannot wait for drying, warming, or futile attempts to remove water.
questions.explanationZh: 呼吸骤停的溺水患者必须按相应指南立即开始复苏——对无呼吸伴心动过缓的婴儿即立即正压通气。缺氧是溺水骤停的根本原因；通气不能因擦干、复温或无意义的排水动作而延误。

questions.questionEn: Following an unplanned home birth in a cold house, a newborn is wrapped in a damp towel and feels cool to the touch, though breathing well with a strong cry. What is the correct thermal management?
questions.questionZh: 在寒冷房屋内意外家中分娩后，新生儿被裹在潮湿毛巾中，触感偏凉，但呼吸良好、哭声有力。正确的体温管理是什么？

options.en: Leave the damp towel in place to avoid stimulation
options.zh: 避免刺激，保留潮湿毛巾

options.en: Cool the environment to keep the infant alert
options.zh: 降低环境温度保持婴儿清醒

options.en: Remove the wet coverings, dry the infant, and cover with warm dry blankets
options.zh: 去除潮湿包裹物，擦干婴儿，改用温暖干燥的毯子包裹

options.en: Immerse the infant in warm water to rewarm rapidly
options.zh: 将婴儿浸入温水中快速复温

questions.explanationEn: Hypothermia management directs removing wet and cold clothing and covering with blankets or dry clothing. Newborns lose heat extremely fast through evaporation; drying and warm dry wrapping are essential, while water immersion in the field is never appropriate.
questions.explanationZh: 低体温处理要求脱去湿冷衣物并用毯子或干燥衣物覆盖。新生儿经蒸发散热极快，必须擦干并用温暖干燥的毯子包裹；院前绝不可采用浸水复温。

questions.questionEn: A 28-year-old female was stung by a wasp 10 minutes ago. She has widespread hives, facial swelling, audible wheeze, and BP 82/50. What is the first-line medication?
questions.questionZh: 一名28岁女性10分钟前被黄蜂蜇伤。全身荨麻疹、面部肿胀、可闻及喘鸣，血压82/50。首选药物是什么？

options.en: Diphenhydramine 50 mg IM
options.zh: 苯海拉明50毫克肌注

options.en: Epinephrine 0.5 mg IM
options.zh: 肾上腺素0.5毫克肌注

options.en: Salbutamol 5 mg nebulized
options.zh: 沙丁胺醇5毫克雾化

options.en: A 500 mL fluid bolus before any medication
options.zh: 任何药物前先快速输液500毫升

questions.explanationEn: Anaphylaxis with allergen exposure and instability (hypotension, respiratory distress) is treated with epinephrine 0.5 mg IM as the first-line drug. Diphenhydramine mitigates medium-term histamine effects and salbutamol treats bronchospasm, but both come after epinephrine.
questions.explanationZh: 接触过敏原并出现不稳定表现（低血压、呼吸窘迫）的过敏性休克，首选肾上腺素0.5毫克肌注。苯海拉明用于缓解中期组胺反应，沙丁胺醇用于支气管痉挛，但都必须在肾上腺素之后。

questions.questionEn: Through which receptor effect does epinephrine relieve bronchospasm in anaphylaxis?
questions.questionZh: 肾上腺素通过哪种受体效应缓解过敏反应中的支气管痉挛？

options.en: Alpha-1 mediated vasoconstriction
options.zh: α1介导的血管收缩

options.en: Beta-1 mediated increased heart rate
options.zh: β1介导的心率增快

options.en: Histamine receptor blockade
options.zh: 组胺受体阻断

options.en: Beta-2 mediated bronchodilation
options.zh: β2介导的支气管扩张

questions.explanationEn: Epinephrine's beta-2 effect produces bronchodilation, while alpha-1 causes vasoconstriction (supporting blood pressure and reducing edema) and beta-1 increases heart rate and contractile force. It does not block histamine receptors — that is the role of diphenhydramine.
questions.explanationZh: 肾上腺素的β2效应产生支气管扩张，α1效应引起血管收缩（升压并减轻水肿），β1效应增加心率和心肌收缩力。它不阻断组胺受体——那是苯海拉明的作用。

questions.questionEn: A 35-year-old with anaphylaxis after eating shellfish has received epinephrine. BP is 86/54. He insists on walking to the ambulance because he "feels a bit better." What is the correct response?
questions.questionZh: 一名35岁男性食用贝类后发生过敏性休克，已注射肾上腺素。血压86/54。他坚持要自己走到救护车，因为"感觉好点了"。正确的做法是什么？

options.en: Allow slow walking with support on each side
options.zh: 允许其在两侧搀扶下缓慢行走

options.en: Let him walk but stop if symptoms return
options.zh: 允许行走，症状再现时停下

options.en: Have him sit upright in the stair chair for comfort
options.zh: 让其坐在楼梯椅上以求舒适

options.en: Keep him supine and carry him; anaphylactic patients must not walk
options.zh: 保持仰卧并抬运；过敏性休克患者不可行走
