questions.explanationEn: The guideline directs positioning the patient supine to improve blood pressure and explicitly states do not walk the patient. In anaphylaxis, sudden postural change or exertion can cause profound hypotension and cardiovascular collapse (empty ventricle syndrome).
questions.explanationZh: 指南要求让患者仰卧以改善血压，并明确规定不可让患者行走。过敏性休克时，突然的体位改变或用力可导致严重低血压和心血管崩溃（空心室综合征）。

questions.questionEn: An adult in anaphylaxis received epinephrine 0.5 mg IM five minutes ago with no improvement: BP remains 84/50 with ongoing stridor. What is the correct epinephrine regimen now?
questions.questionZh: 一名成人过敏性休克患者5分钟前肌注肾上腺素0.5毫克，无改善：血压仍为84/50，喘鸣持续。现在肾上腺素应如何继续使用？

options.en: No further doses; a single dose is the maximum
options.zh: 不再给药；单次剂量即为上限

options.en: Repeat 0.5 mg IM every 5 minutes, up to 3 repeats
options.zh: 每5分钟重复肌注0.5毫克，最多重复3次

options.en: Switch to 1 mg IV push
options.zh: 改为静脉推注1毫克

options.en: Halve the dose to 0.25 mg for the repeat
options.zh: 重复剂量减半至0.25毫克

questions.explanationEn: The adult anaphylaxis dose is 0.5 mg IM every 5 minutes, repeated up to 3 times as needed. IM onset is 5-15 minutes. IV push epinephrine is not a PCP anaphylaxis route in these guidelines.
questions.explanationZh: 成人过敏性休克剂量为肾上腺素0.5毫克肌注，每5分钟一次，按需最多重复3次。肌注起效时间5-15分钟。静脉推注肾上腺素不属于本指南中PCP的过敏反应给药途径。

questions.questionEn: A 72-year-old male with coronary artery disease develops anaphylaxis after a new antibiotic: stridor, hypotension 78/44, decreased LOC. Your partner hesitates to give epinephrine because of his cardiac history. What is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名72岁冠心病男性服用新抗生素后发生过敏性休克：喘鸣、低血压78/44、意识水平下降。搭档因其心脏病史犹豫是否给肾上腺素。正确的做法是什么？

options.en: Withhold epinephrine and rely on diphenhydramine
options.zh: 不给肾上腺素，改用苯海拉明

options.en: Give half the usual dose due to cardiac risk
options.zh: 因心脏风险给予常规剂量的一半

options.en: Administer epinephrine 0.5 mg IM; there are no absolute contraindications in life-threatening anaphylaxis
options.zh: 肌注肾上腺素0.5毫克；危及生命的过敏反应无绝对禁忌证

options.en: Wait for ALS backup to make the decision
options.zh: 等待高级生命支持人员到场决定

questions.explanationEn: The epinephrine monograph states there are no absolute contraindications to epinephrine in life-threatening situations such as anaphylaxis. Untreated anaphylaxis is fatal; cardiac history warrants monitoring but never withholding the drug in an unstable patient.
questions.explanationZh: 肾上腺素药物专论明确：在过敏性休克等危及生命的情况下，肾上腺素无绝对禁忌证。不治疗的过敏性休克是致命的；心脏病史需要加强监测，但绝不能因此对不稳定患者停用该药。

questions.questionEn: A 6-year-old weighing 20 kg is in anaphylaxis after peanut exposure: hives, facial swelling, wheeze, and lethargy. What is the correct epinephrine dose?
questions.questionZh: 一名体重20公斤的6岁儿童接触花生后发生过敏性休克：荨麻疹、面部肿胀、喘息、精神萎靡。肾上腺素的正确剂量是多少？

options.en: 0.2 mg IM (0.01 mg/kg)
options.zh: 0.2毫克肌注（0.01毫克/公斤）

options.en: 0.5 mg IM, the same as an adult
options.zh: 0.5毫克肌注，与成人相同

options.en: 2 mg IM (0.1 mg/kg)
options.zh: 2毫克肌注（0.1毫克/公斤）

options.en: 0.02 mg IM (0.001 mg/kg)
options.zh: 0.02毫克肌注（0.001毫克/公斤）

questions.explanationEn: The pediatric epinephrine dose is 0.01 mg/kg IM to a maximum of 0.5 mg, repeatable up to 3 times. For a 20 kg child: 0.01 × 20 = 0.2 mg IM.
questions.explanationZh: 儿童肾上腺素剂量为0.01毫克/公斤肌注，最大0.5毫克，最多可重复3次。20公斤儿童：0.01×20=0.2毫克肌注。

questions.questionEn: A 68-year-old female in anaphylaxis received epinephrine 0.5 mg IM. Her BP has risen to 104/66 but she still has audible wheeze and mild dyspnea. What should the PCP do next for the bronchospasm?
questions.questionZh: 一名68岁女性过敏性休克，已肌注肾上腺素0.5毫克。血压回升至104/66，但仍可闻及喘鸣并有轻度呼吸困难。PCP接下来应如何处理支气管痉挛？

options.en: Administer nebulized salbutamol, now that epinephrine has been given
options.zh: 在已给肾上腺素的基础上给予沙丁胺醇雾化

options.en: Give a second dose of epinephrine immediately regardless of response
options.zh: 不论反应如何立即再给一剂肾上腺素

options.en: Administer nitroglycerin to reduce pulmonary congestion
options.zh: 给予硝酸甘油以减轻肺淤血

options.en: Withhold all further medication and transport
options.zh: 停止一切用药并转运

questions.explanationEn: Additional PCP interventions in anaphylaxis include treating bronchospasm with salbutamol AFTER epinephrine has been administered. Salbutamol relieves the residual wheeze; epinephrine remains the primary drug and may be repeated at 5-minute intervals if instability persists.
questions.explanationZh: 过敏性休克的PCP附加处置包括在给予肾上腺素之后用沙丁胺醇治疗支气管痉挛。沙丁胺醇缓解残余喘鸣；肾上腺素仍是首选药物，若不稳定持续可每5分钟重复。

questions.questionEn: A 44-year-old male in anaphylaxis has been stabilized with epinephrine. What is the purpose of administering diphenhydramine?
questions.questionZh: 一名44岁男性过敏性休克已用肾上腺素稳定。给予苯海拉明的目的是什么？

options.en: To reverse airway edema faster than epinephrine
options.zh: 比肾上腺素更快逆转气道水肿

options.en: To mitigate medium-term effects and limit the histamine response
options.zh: 缓解中期效应并限制组胺反应

options.en: To raise blood pressure through vasoconstriction
options.zh: 通过血管收缩升高血压

options.en: To provide bronchodilation as a substitute for salbutamol
options.zh: 作为沙丁胺醇的替代提供支气管扩张

questions.explanationEn: Diphenhydramine is given to mitigate medium-term effects and limit the histamine response, competing with histamine for receptor sites on effector cells. It is an adjunct — it does not replace epinephrine for airway or blood pressure, nor salbutamol for bronchospasm.
questions.explanationZh: 给予苯海拉明是为了缓解中期效应并限制组胺反应，它与组胺竞争效应细胞上的受体位点。它是辅助用药——既不能替代肾上腺素改善气道和血压，也不能替代沙丁胺醇解除支气管痉挛。

questions.questionEn: A 9-year-old developed hives and vomiting 10 minutes after eating a cookie containing nuts. She is alert, BP 104/68, SpO2 98%, no wheeze or stridor. Her mother asks whether she needs an epinephrine injection. What is the correct assessment?
questions.questionZh: 一名9岁女童食用含坚果饼干后10分钟出现荨麻疹和呕吐。意识清醒，血压104/68，SpO2 98%，无喘息或喘鸣。母亲询问是否需要注射肾上腺素。正确的判断是什么？

options.en: No epinephrine ever; hives alone are always benign
options.zh: 永远不用肾上腺素；单纯荨麻疹总是良性的

options.en: Give diphenhydramine only and leave her at home
options.zh: 仅给苯海拉明并让其留在家中

options.en: She meets the criteria now because two body systems are involved
options.zh: 她现已达标，因为累及两个系统

options.en: She does not yet meet the unstable criteria, but requires close monitoring and immediate epinephrine if instability develops
options.zh: 目前尚未达到不稳定标准，但需密切监测，一旦出现不稳定立即给肾上腺素

questions.explanationEn: BC's anaphylaxis indication requires signs of anaphylaxis, allergen exposure, AND instability: syncope, decreased LOC, hypotension (BP < 90 mmHg), or respiratory distress. She currently has none of these. Allergic reactions can progress rapidly, so continuous monitoring with epinephrine ready is essential and transport is required.
questions.explanationZh: BC的过敏性休克指征要求同时具备：过敏反应体征、过敏原暴露和不稳定表现（晕厥、意识下降、低血压BP<90mmHg或呼吸窘迫）。她目前均不符合。但过敏反应可迅速进展，必须持续监测、备好肾上腺素并转运。

questions.questionEn: A 31-year-old male was stung by a bee on the forearm and is in anaphylaxis. The stinger is still embedded in the skin. Along with epinephrine, what should be done about the stinger?
questions.questionZh: 一名31岁男性前臂被蜜蜂蜇伤后发生过敏性休克。螫针仍留在皮肤内。在给予肾上腺素的同时，螫针应如何处理？

options.en: Leave it in place; removal releases more venom
options.zh: 保留原位；取出会释放更多毒液

options.en: Squeeze it out between two fingers
options.zh: 用两指挤出螫针

options.en: Apply a tourniquet above the sting site
options.zh: 在蜇伤部位近端使用止血带

options.en: Scrape the stinger off to remove the allergen
options.zh: 刮除螫针以清除过敏原

questions.explanationEn: The guideline directs removing the allergen, giving scraping off any stinger(s) as the specific example. Scraping avoids compressing the attached venom sac, which squeezing with fingers or forceps would do.
questions.explanationZh: 指南要求清除过敏原，并明确举例为刮除螫针。刮除可避免挤压附着的毒囊，而用手指或镊子挤压则会将毒液挤入。

questions.questionEn: A 26-year-old male is found unresponsive in an alley with a syringe nearby. Respirations are 4 per minute and shallow, pupils pinpoint, SpO2 78%. What is the immediate priority?
questions.questionZh: 一名26岁男性被发现在小巷中无反应，旁边有注射器。呼吸4次/分且浅，瞳孔针尖样，SpO2 78%。当务之急是什么？

options.en: Manage the airway and support ventilations with oxygen to reach SpO2 ≥ 94%
options.zh: 管理气道并辅助通气给氧，使SpO2达到94%及以上

options.en: Give naloxone 0.4 mg IM before any airway intervention
options.zh: 任何气道处置前先肌注纳洛酮0.4毫克

options.en: Apply a non-rebreather mask and await naloxone effect
options.zh: 戴上非再吸入面罩等待纳洛酮起效

options.en: Perform a sternal rub and reassess in 2 minutes
options.zh: 胸骨摩擦刺激后2分钟复评

questions.explanationEn: The narcotic overdose guideline directs completing a primary survey first: airway managed with positioning, suctioning, and adjuncts; ventilations supported as required (consider two-person BVM); oxygen to maintain SpO2 ≥ 94%. Naloxone follows — it takes 3 minutes IM, during which the hypoxic patient must be ventilated.
questions.explanationZh: 麻醉药过量指南要求先完成初步评估：通过体位、抽吸和辅助器械管理气道；按需辅助通气（可考虑双人球囊面罩）；给氧维持SpO2≥94%。纳洛酮随后使用——肌注需3分钟起效，其间必须为缺氧患者通气。

questions.questionEn: Beyond decreased LOC and depressed respiratory drive, which set of findings is consistent with opioid overdose per BC guidelines?
questions.questionZh: 根据BC指南，除意识水平下降和呼吸驱动抑制外，下列哪组表现符合阿片类药物过量？

options.en: Dilated pupils, hypertension, and hyperthermia
options.zh: 瞳孔散大、高血压、体温升高

options.en: Pinpoint pupils, hypotension, hypothermia, and tachycardia
options.zh: 针尖样瞳孔、低血压、体温过低、心动过速

options.en: Unequal pupils, bradycardia, and hypertension
options.zh: 瞳孔不等大、心动过缓、高血压

options.en: Pinpoint pupils, hypertension, and fever
options.zh: 针尖样瞳孔、高血压、发热

questions.explanationEn: BC lists pinpoint pupils (miosis), hypotension, hypothermia, and tachycardia as additional signs of opioid overdose, alongside decreased LOC and depressed respiratory drive shown by both decreased rate and limited tidal volume.
questions.explanationZh: BC指南列出的阿片类过量附加体征为针尖样瞳孔（瞳孔缩小）、低血压、体温过低和心动过速，同时伴意识水平下降和呼吸驱动抑制（呼吸频率下降且潮气量不足）。

questions.questionEn: A 71-year-old male on long-term opioids for cancer pain is drowsy with respirations of 6. You gave naloxone 0.4 mg IM. Three minutes later his SpO2 is 90% and he is ventilating at 8 per minute. What is the next dose?
questions.questionZh: 一名71岁癌痛患者长期使用阿片类药物，现嗜睡，呼吸6次/分。你已肌注纳洛酮0.4毫克。3分钟后SpO2 90%，呼吸8次/分。下一剂应给多少？

options.en: Repeat 0.4 mg, then stop if there is no further change
options.zh: 重复0.4毫克，若无进一步变化则停止

options.en: Give 4 mg IN as the next escalation
options.zh: 下一步升级为鼻内4毫克

options.en: 0.8 mg IM or IV
options.zh: 0.8毫克肌注或静注

options.en: No further naloxone; wait 15 minutes
options.zh: 不再给纳洛酮；等待15分钟

questions.explanationEn: The naloxone escalation is 0.4 mg, then after 3 minutes 0.4 mg, then 0.8 mg, then 2.0 mg, each given if SpO2 ≥ 94% and ventilating > 10 have not been achieved. He has met neither endpoint, so the escalation continues. Ventilatory support continues throughout.
questions.explanationZh: 纳洛酮的递增方案为0.4毫克，3分钟后0.4毫克，再0.8毫克，再2.0毫克，每次均在SpO2未达94%且呼吸未超过10次/分时给予。他两项终点均未达到，故继续递增。全程持续通气支持。

questions.questionEn: A 33-year-old suspected opioid overdose has received escalating naloxone to a total of 3.6 mg with adequate BVM ventilation throughout. He remains unresponsive with pupils now mid-sized. What is the most important consideration?
questions.questionZh: 一名33岁疑似阿片类过量患者已递增使用纳洛酮累计3.6毫克，全程球囊面罩通气充分。仍无反应，瞳孔现为中等大小。最重要的考虑是什么？

options.en: Give a further 4 mg IN dose immediately
options.zh: 立即追加鼻内4毫克

options.en: Assume he is faking and reduce ventilatory support
options.zh: 认定其装病并减少通气支持

options.en: Restrain him in anticipation of combativeness
options.zh: 预判躁动而对其进行约束

options.en: Reconsider the cause — check blood glucose and look for other causes of decreased LOC — while continuing ventilation and transport
options.zh: 重新考虑病因——检查血糖并寻找意识下降的其他原因——同时继续通气并转运

questions.explanationEn: The full naloxone sequence (0.4, 0.4, 0.8, 2.0 mg) has been completed without response and the pupils are no longer miotic, so opioid toxicity alone does not explain the picture. Baseline vitals must include a blood glucose level, and a glucose of 4 mmol/L or less must be corrected. Ventilation is the life-saving intervention and continues en route.
questions.explanationZh: 完整的纳洛酮序列（0.4、0.4、0.8、2.0毫克）已用完仍无反应且瞳孔不再缩小，单纯阿片中毒无法解释病情。基线生命体征必须包含血糖，血糖≤4mmol/L须纠正。通气才是救命措施，应在转运途中持续进行。

questions.questionEn: What are the treatment endpoints that determine whether a further dose of naloxone is required?
questions.questionZh: 判断是否需要追加纳洛酮的治疗终点是什么？

options.en: An SpO2 of at least 94% and a ventilation rate greater than 10 per minute
options.zh: SpO2至少94%且呼吸频率大于10次/分

options.en: Full return to GCS 15 and normal pupil size
options.zh: 完全恢复至GCS 15分且瞳孔大小正常

options.en: A systolic blood pressure above 110 mmHg
options.zh: 收缩压超过110mmHg

options.en: The ability to walk unassisted to the ambulance
options.zh: 能够无搀扶走向救护车

questions.explanationEn: Each escalating naloxone dose is given after 3 minutes if an SpO2 of ≥ 94% and ventilating > 10 have not been achieved. The goal is adequate oxygenation and ventilation, not full arousal — over-reversal precipitates withdrawal and combativeness.
questions.explanationZh: 每次递增的纳洛酮剂量均在3分钟后、SpO2未达94%且呼吸未超过10次/分时给予。目标是充分的氧合与通气，而非完全唤醒——过度逆转会诱发戒断和躁动。

questions.questionEn: A 15-year-old is found unresponsive at a party with respirations of 5, pinpoint pupils, SpO2 82%. Bystanders report he took a pill. IV access has not been obtained. Which naloxone route has the fastest onset among those available?
questions.questionZh: 一名15岁少年在聚会上被发现无反应，呼吸5次/分，瞳孔针尖样，SpO2 82%。旁观者称其服用了药片。尚未建立静脉通路。在可用途径中，纳洛酮哪种给药途径起效最快？

options.en: Oral, at 1 minute
options.zh: 口服，1分钟

options.en: IM or IN, both at approximately 3 minutes
options.zh: 肌注或鼻内，均约3分钟

options.en: IM at 15 minutes
options.zh: 肌注，15分钟

options.en: IN at 20 minutes
options.zh: 鼻内，20分钟

questions.explanationEn: Naloxone onset is IV 1 minute, IM 3 minutes, and IN 3 minutes. Without IV access, IM (0.4 mg) or IN (4 mg) both act in about 3 minutes. There is no oral route for naloxone. Ventilation with oxygen continues while the drug takes effect.
questions.explanationZh: 纳洛酮起效时间为静注1分钟、肌注3分钟、鼻内3分钟。无静脉通路时，肌注（0.4毫克）或鼻内（4毫克）均约3分钟起效。纳洛酮没有口服途径。药物起效期间应持续给氧通气。

questions.questionEn: After naloxone, a 29-year-old opioid overdose patient wakes suddenly, is agitated and diaphoretic, vomits, and demands to leave. What is the safest management approach?
questions.questionZh: 使用纳洛酮后，一名29岁阿片类过量患者突然苏醒，躁动、大汗、呕吐并要求离开。最安全的处理方式是什么？

options.en: Give a further naloxone dose to keep him fully awake
options.zh: 再给一剂纳洛酮以保持其完全清醒

options.en: Let him leave immediately since he is now alert
options.zh: 因其已清醒立即让他离开

options.en: Protect the airway from vomit, de-escalate calmly, and strongly encourage transport as naloxone may wear off before the opioid
options.zh: 防止呕吐物误吸，冷静安抚降级冲突，强烈建议转运，因纳洛酮作用可能先于阿片类消退

options.en: Physically restrain him and transport without further assessment
options.zh: 对其进行躯体约束并不再评估直接转运

questions.explanationEn: Documented naloxone adverse effects include reversal of narcotic effect with combativeness, withdrawal signs, nausea and vomiting, sweating, and tachycardia. Naloxone's duration can be shorter than the opioid's, so re-sedation and respiratory depression can recur. Airway protection, de-escalation, and transport are the priorities; more naloxone worsens withdrawal.
questions.explanationZh: 纳洛酮已知的不良反应包括逆转麻醉效应伴躁动、戒断表现、恶心呕吐、出汗和心动过速。纳洛酮作用时间可能短于阿片类药物，可再次出现镇静和呼吸抑制。优先保护气道、降级冲突并转运；追加纳洛酮只会加重戒断。

questions.questionEn: An 80-year-old female remains unconscious and apneic after IM naloxone. As a PCP, what additional intervention does the guideline direct?
questions.questionZh: 一名80岁女性肌注纳洛酮后仍昏迷且呼吸停止。作为PCP，指南要求追加哪项处置？

options.en: Withhold further naloxone due to her age
options.zh: 因其年龄不再给纳洛酮

options.en: Give oral glucose to rule out hypoglycemia
options.zh: 口服葡萄糖以排除低血糖

options.en: Administer glucagon 1 mg IM
options.zh: 肌注胰高血糖素1毫克

options.en: Establish vascular access and give naloxone intravenously
options.zh: 建立静脉通路并静脉给予纳洛酮

questions.explanationEn: Additional PCP interventions for narcotic overdose state that in cases of continued unconsciousness and apnea, consider establishing vascular access and giving naloxone intravenously. IV onset is 1 minute versus 3 minutes IM. Oral glucose is contraindicated in a patient who cannot protect her airway.
questions.explanationZh: 麻醉药过量的PCP附加处置规定：若持续昏迷且呼吸停止，应考虑建立静脉通路并静脉给予纳洛酮。静注1分钟起效，肌注需3分钟。无法保护气道的患者禁用口服葡萄糖。

questions.questionEn: A 34-year-old known type 1 diabetic is pale, sweaty, and confused but able to follow commands and swallow safely. Blood glucose is 2.8 mmol/L. What is the appropriate initial treatment?
questions.questionZh: 一名34岁已知1型糖尿病患者面色苍白、出汗、意识混乱，但能遵嘱且可安全吞咽。血糖2.8mmol/L。恰当的初始治疗是什么？

options.en: Apply glucose gel to the oral mucosa
options.zh: 将葡萄糖凝胶涂于口腔黏膜

options.en: Administer glucagon 1 mg IM
options.zh: 肌注胰高血糖素1毫克

options.en: Withhold glucose until IV access is obtained
options.zh: 建立静脉通路前不给糖

options.en: Give 25 g of D10W IV immediately
options.zh: 立即静脉给予D10W 25克

questions.explanationEn: For suspected hypoglycemia with BGL < 4.0 mmol/L, patients with sufficient mentation to maintain an airway receive glucose gel applied to the oral mucosa (15 g PO, repeatable at 5 minutes, no limit). Glucagon is for patients with insufficient mentation or an unprotected airway, or when IV access fails.
questions.explanationZh: 疑似低血糖（血糖<4.0mmol/L）时，意识足以维持气道的患者应将葡萄糖凝胶涂于口腔黏膜（15克口服，5分钟可重复，无上限）。胰高血糖素用于意识不足、气道无保护，或静脉通路建立失败的患者。

questions.questionEn: A 76-year-old diabetic male is unresponsive with snoring respirations. Blood glucose is 2.1 mmol/L. Two IV attempts have failed. What is the correct treatment?
questions.questionZh: 一名76岁糖尿病男性无反应，有鼾声呼吸。血糖2.1mmol/L。两次静脉穿刺均失败。正确的治疗是什么？

options.en: Place glucose gel under his tongue and monitor
options.zh: 将葡萄糖凝胶置于舌下并观察

options.en: Administer glucagon 0.5-1 mg IM
options.zh: 肌注胰高血糖素0.5-1毫克

options.en: Continue IV attempts throughout transport with no other treatment
options.zh: 转运全程继续尝试静脉穿刺，不予其他治疗

options.en: Give D10W by the intramuscular route
options.zh: 经肌肉途径给予D10W

questions.explanationEn: When IV access attempts have been unsuccessful, glucagon is indicated: 0.5-1 mg IM (or 3 mg IN, repeated after 15 minutes if no clinical response). Oral glucose is contraindicated because he cannot protect his airway, and D10W is an IV-only preparation.
questions.explanationZh: 静脉穿刺尝试失败时应使用胰高血糖素：0.5-1毫克肌注（或鼻内3毫克，15分钟无临床反应可重复）。口服葡萄糖禁用于无法保护气道者，D10W只能静脉给药。

questions.questionEn: A PCP has obtained vascular access on a 41-year-old with a confirmed blood glucose of 1.9 mmol/L and decreased LOC. What is the correct D10W dose?
questions.questionZh: 一名41岁患者确诊血糖1.9mmol/L伴意识下降，PCP已建立静脉通路。D10W的正确剂量是多少？

options.en: 25-50 g (250-500 mL of 10% solution)
1-2 g (10-20 mL of 10% solution)
10-25 g (100-250 mL of 10% solution)
50 g (50 mL of 50% solution)

questions.explanationEn: D10W is dosed 10-25 g, which is 100-250 mL of the 10% solution, IV, with immediate onset. There are no contraindications, but extravasation causes tissue necrosis so the IV site must be checked.
questions.explanationZh: D10W剂量为10-25克，即10%溶液100-250毫升，静脉给药，立即起效。该药无禁忌证，但外渗会导致组织坏死，故必须检查静脉穿刺部位。

questions.questionEn: An 83-year-old diabetic woman has sudden right-sided weakness and slurred speech. She is alert. Blood glucose is 3.4 mmol/L. What is the correct approach?
questions.questionZh: 一名83岁糖尿病女性突发右侧肢体无力和言语含糊。意识清醒。血糖3.4mmol/L。正确的处置是什么？

options.en: Treat as a stroke only and transport without correcting the glucose
options.zh: 仅按卒中处理，不纠正血糖直接转运

options.en: Delay all treatment until a CT scan can be arranged
options.zh: 推迟一切治疗，等待CT检查

options.en: Give a fluid bolus to improve cerebral perfusion
options.zh: 快速输液以改善脑灌注

options.en: Correct the hypoglycemia and reassess the neurological deficit, while still treating as a possible stroke with timely transport and notification
options.zh: 纠正低血糖并复评神经功能缺损，同时仍按可能的卒中及时转运并预先通知医院

questions.explanationEn: Hypoglycemia below 4.0 mmol/L can mimic stroke and must be corrected — the diabetic guideline also directs evaluating for stroke signs and symptoms, and blood glucose check is a required stroke intervention. If the deficit resolves with glucose it was hypoglycemia; if it persists, stroke care continues with timely transport and notification of the receiving facility.
questions.explanationZh: 血糖低于4.0mmol/L可模拟卒中表现，必须纠正——糖尿病指南同样要求评估卒中症状体征，而血糖检查也是卒中处置的必需项目。若纠正血糖后缺损消失则为低血糖；若持续存在，则继续按卒中处理，及时转运并预先通知接收医院。

questions.questionEn: A 10-year-old type 1 diabetic is drowsy but rousable and can swallow after playing soccer without eating. Blood glucose is 3.1 mmol/L. Five minutes after glucose gel he is still drowsy and his repeat glucose is 3.3 mmol/L. What should you do?
questions.questionZh: 一名10岁1型糖尿病患儿踢球后未进食，现嗜睡但可唤醒且能吞咽。血糖3.1mmol/L。使用葡萄糖凝胶5分钟后仍嗜睡，复测血糖3.3mmol/L。你应该怎么做？

options.en: Repeat the oral glucose, as it may be repeated at 5 minutes with no limit
options.zh: 重复口服葡萄糖，因其可在5分钟后重复且无上限

options.en: Switch immediately to glucagon since the gel has failed
options.zh: 因凝胶无效立即改用胰高血糖素

options.en: Stop treatment and transport; two doses is the maximum
options.zh: 停止治疗并转运；最多只能给两剂

options.en: Give the child a large meal to raise the glucose faster
options.zh: 给患儿吃一顿大餐以更快升高血糖

questions.explanationEn: Oral glucose is 15 g PO, repeated at 5 minutes as necessary with no limit, for known or suspected hypoglycemia in a conscious patient with no risk of aspiration or choking. He still maintains his airway, so oral therapy continues; glucagon is reserved for insufficient mentation or an unprotected airway.
questions.explanationZh: 口服葡萄糖为15克，必要时5分钟后重复且无上限，适用于意识清醒、无误吸或窒息风险的已知或疑似低血糖患者。他仍能维持气道，故继续口服治疗；胰高血糖素保留给意识不足或气道无保护者。

questions.questionEn: At what blood glucose level does BC define suspected hypoglycemia requiring correction?
questions.questionZh: BC指南将需要纠正的疑似低血糖定义在血糖低于多少？

options.en: Below 6.0 mmol/L
options.zh: 低于6.0mmol/L

options.en: Below 4.0 mmol/L
options.zh: 低于4.0mmol/L

options.en: Below 2.0 mmol/L
options.zh: 低于2.0mmol/L

options.en: Below 8.0 mmol/L
options.zh: 低于8.0mmol/L

questions.explanationEn: Suspected hypoglycemia requiring correction is a BGL below 4.0 mmol/L. The same threshold appears in the narcotic overdose guideline, where a blood glucose of 4 mmol/L or less must be corrected, and TBI care targets a normal range of 4.0-8.0 mmol/L.
questions.explanationZh: 需要纠正的疑似低血糖定义为血糖低于4.0mmol/L。麻醉药过量指南采用同一阈值，血糖≤4mmol/L须纠正；颅脑损伤处置则以4.0-8.0mmol/L的正常范围为目标。

questions.questionEn: An 88-year-old diabetic male is unresponsive with a BGL of 1.7 mmol/L and vomiting. He is breathing spontaneously at 14 per minute. Before drug therapy, how should he be positioned?
questions.questionZh: 一名88岁糖尿病男性无反应，血糖1.7mmol/L，伴呕吐。自主呼吸14次/分。在药物治疗前应如何摆放体位？

options.en: Supine with the head of the bed flat
options.zh: 仰卧，床头放平

options.en: Sitting fully upright with legs dependent
options.zh: 完全坐直，双腿下垂

options.en: In the lateral or three-quarter prone position, with suction ready
options.zh: 侧卧位或3/4俯卧位，备好抽吸

options.en: Trendelenburg to improve cerebral glucose delivery
options.zh: 头低足高位以改善脑部葡萄糖供应

questions.explanationEn: The diabetic emergencies guideline directs positioning the patient in the lateral or 3/4 prone position if needed, with the airway managed by positioning, suctioning, and adjunct insertion. An unresponsive vomiting patient must be positioned to protect the airway before any drug is given.
questions.explanationZh: 糖尿病急症指南要求按需将患者置于侧卧位或3/4俯卧位，并通过体位、抽吸和辅助器械管理气道。无反应且呕吐的患者必须先摆好保护气道的体位，再给予任何药物。

questions.questionEn: You are called to a 2-week-old who is lethargic, floppy, and feeding poorly. Airway and breathing are adequate. What must be included in the baseline vital signs?
questions.questionZh: 你出诊一名2周大的婴儿，表现为嗜睡、肌张力低下、进食差。气道和呼吸尚可。基线生命体征必须包括什么？

options.en: A blood glucose level, since decreased LOC without a known cause requires it
options.zh: 血糖水平，因原因不明的意识下降必须测血糖

options.en: A 12-lead ECG before any other assessment
options.zh: 其他评估前先做12导联心电图

options.en: Only heart rate and respiratory rate; glucose is not measured in neonates
options.zh: 仅测心率和呼吸；新生儿不测血糖

options.en: An orthostatic blood pressure
options.zh: 体位性血压

questions.explanationEn: Diabetic emergencies indications include decreased LOC patients without a known cause, and the guideline directs obtaining a baseline set of vital signs including a blood glucose level. Neonates have minimal glycogen stores and become hypoglycemic quickly with poor feeding, so glucose must be measured.
questions.explanationZh: 糖尿病急症的适应证包括原因不明的意识下降患者，指南要求获取包含血糖在内的基线生命体征。新生儿糖原储备极少，进食差时很快出现低血糖，因此必须测量血糖。
